# Project Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# ---- PROJECT SETUP ----------------------------------------------------------

required_packages <- c(
  "readxl", "readr", "dplyr", "tidyr", "stringr", "purrr", "lubridate", "janitor",
  "here", "ggplot2", "scales", "tibble", "forcats", "cluster", "fixest", "dendextend",
  "mclust", "pheatmap", "viridisLite", "knitr")

missing_packages <- required_packages[!vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(paste0("Install the following package(s) before running the notebook: ",
              paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", ")))
}

invisible(lapply(required_packages, library, character.only = TRUE))

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE, scipen = 999)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6, dpi = 150, fig.retina = 1)
```

# Datasets

```{r import-agreement-metadata}
# ---- IMPORT AGREEMENT METADATA
agreements <- read_excel(
  here::here("DTA 2.0 - Vertical Content (v2).xlsx"),
  sheet = "Agreements") %>%
  transmute(
    Agreement = Agreement,
    RTA_ID = as.character(`RTA ID`),
    WB_ID = as.character(`WB ID`),
    Status = Status,
    Date_EIF_G = as_date(`Date of Entry into Force (G)`))

# ---- Validation
stopifnot(anyDuplicated(agreements$RTA_ID) == 0)

cat("Agreement dataset loaded\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(agreements), "\n")
cat("Columns:", ncol(agreements), "\n")
```

## Agreement × Provision Matrix

```{r build-agreement-provision-matrix}
provisions_raw <- read_excel(
  here::here("DTA 2.0 - Vertical Content (v2).xlsx"),
  sheet = "Dataset_Clean")

meta_vars <- c(
  "Chapter",
  "Policy Area",
  "Sub Area",
  "Policy_Prov_Code",
  "Prov_Code",
  "Description")

provisions_long <- provisions_raw %>%
  mutate(
    across(-all_of(meta_vars), as.character)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -all_of(meta_vars),
    names_to = "RTA_ID",
    values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(RTA_ID = as.character(RTA_ID))

provision_matrix <- provisions_long %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = RTA_ID,
    names_from = Policy_Prov_Code,
    values_from = value)

agreements_raw <- agreements %>%
  left_join(provision_matrix, by = "RTA_ID")

# Validation
stopifnot(anyDuplicated(provision_matrix$RTA_ID) == 0)

cat("Provision matrix created\n")
cat("Agreements:", nrow(agreements_raw), "\n")
cat("Provision variables:", ncol(provision_matrix) - 1, "\n")
```

## Bilateral Agreements

```{r import-bilateral-agreement-information}
# ---- IMPORT BILATERAL AGREEMENT INFORMATION --------------------------------------------
bilateral_agreements <- read_excel(
  here::here("DTA 2.0 - Vertical Content (v2).xlsx"),
  sheet = "Bilateral Information") %>%
  transmute(
    iso1 = iso1,
    iso2 = iso2,
    Agreement = rta_name,
    WB_ID = as.character(WBID),
    year = year,
    economy1 = Economy1,
    economy2 = Economy2) %>%
  filter(year >= 1995)

# ---- Match bilateral observations to agreement metadata ----
bilateral_agreements <- bilateral_agreements %>%
  left_join(agreements %>%
      select(RTA_ID, WB_ID),
    by = "WB_ID")

# ---- Validation --------------------------------------------
stopifnot(!all(is.na(bilateral_agreements$RTA_ID)))

cat("Bilateral agreement data loaded\n")
cat("Observations:", nrow(bilateral_agreements), "\n")
cat("Unique agreements:", n_distinct(bilateral_agreements$RTA_ID), "\n")

# ---- FILTER AGREEMENTS TO THOSE PRESENT IN BILATERAL DATA
agreements_matched <- agreements_raw %>%
  semi_join(bilateral_agreements %>%
      distinct(RTA_ID),
    by = "RTA_ID")

# ---- Validation --------------------------------------------
stopifnot(nrow(agreements_matched) <= nrow(agreements_raw))

cat("Agreement filtering completed\n")
cat("Agreements before:", nrow(agreements_raw), "\n")
cat("Agreements after :", nrow(agreements_matched), "\n")
```

# Missingness

```{r agreement-level-missingness-analysis}
# ---- AGREEMENT-LEVEL MISSINGNESS ANALYSIS -----------------------------------

# Metadata and provision variables
meta_vars <- c(
  "Agreement",
  "RTA_ID",
  "WB_ID",
  "Status",
  "Date_EIF_G")

provision_vars <- setdiff(names(agreements_matched), meta_vars)

# Calculate agreement-level missingness --------------------------------------
agreements_missingness <- agreements_matched %>%
  mutate(
    na_count = rowSums(is.na(across(all_of(provision_vars)))),
    pct_missing = round(
      na_count / length(provision_vars) * 100, 2))

# Categorise agreements
fully_uncoded <- agreements_missingness %>%
  filter(pct_missing >= 99)

partially_uncoded <- agreements_missingness %>%
  filter(
    pct_missing > 0,
    pct_missing < 99) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_missing))

# ---- Missingness summary ---------------------------------------------------

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("AGREEMENT CODING SUMMARY\n")
cat("==============================\n")
cat("Total agreements:      ",
    nrow(agreements_missingness), "\n")

cat("Fully uncoded:         ",
    nrow(fully_uncoded), "\n")

cat("Partially uncoded:     ",
    nrow(partially_uncoded), "\n")

cat("Fully coded:           ",
    nrow(agreements_missingness) -
      nrow(fully_uncoded) -
      nrow(partially_uncoded),
    "\n\n")

print(
  partially_uncoded %>%
    select(
      Agreement,
      RTA_ID,
      pct_missing,
      na_count))

# ---- Remove agreements excluded from the analysis -------------------------
agreements_filtered <- agreements_missingness %>%
  filter(
    pct_missing < 99,
    abs(pct_missing - 18.58) > 0.01,
    Agreement !=
      "Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus)") %>%
  select(
    -na_count,
    -pct_missing)

# ---- Filtering summary --------------------------------------------
cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("FILTERING SUMMARY\n")
cat("==============================\n")
cat("Before filtering: ",
    nrow(agreements_matched), "\n")

cat("After filtering:  ",
    nrow(agreements_filtered), "\n")

cat("Removed:          ",
    nrow(agreements_matched) -
      nrow(agreements_filtered),
    "\n")

cat("Fully uncoded:    ",
    nrow(fully_uncoded), "\n")

cat("EU treaties:      ",
    sum(abs(agreements_missingness$pct_missing - 18.58) <= 0.01),
    "\n")

cat("PACER Plus:        1\n")

# Validation
stopifnot(
  nrow(agreements_filtered) <
    nrow(agreements_matched))
```

# Variance check

```{r provision-level-variance-check, results="hide"}
# ---- PROVISION-LEVEL VARIANCE CHECK -----------------------------------------

# Identify provision variables
provision_vars <- setdiff(names(agreements_filtered), meta_vars)

# Helper function: retain valid observations only
valid_values <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x[!is.na(x) & x != "" & x != "NR"]
}

# Calculate variation statistics
variance_summary <- tibble(
  Policy_Prov_Code = provision_vars) %>%
  mutate(
    n_valid = sapply(
      provision_vars,
      function(var) length(valid_values(agreements_filtered[[var]]))),

    n_unique = sapply(
      provision_vars,
      function(var) n_distinct(valid_values(agreements_filtered[[var]]))),

    max_prop = sapply(
      provision_vars,
      function(var) {

        values <- valid_values(agreements_filtered[[var]])

        if (length(values) == 0) {
          return(NA_real_)}
        max(table(values)) / length(values)}),

    max_prop_pct = round(max_prop * 100, 2),

    flag = case_when(
      n_unique == 0    ~ "NO DATA – DROP",
      n_unique == 1    ~ "ALL SAME – DROP",
      max_prop >= 0.99 ~ ">=99% SAME – DROP",
      max_prop >= 0.95 ~ "95–99% SAME – LOW VAR",
      TRUE             ~ "OK")) %>%
  left_join(
    provisions_raw %>%
      select(
        Policy_Prov_Code,
        Description) %>%
      distinct(),
    by = "Policy_Prov_Code") %>%
  arrange(desc(max_prop_pct))

# Variance summary
cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("PROVISION VARIANCE SUMMARY\n")
cat("==============================\n\n")

variance_summary %>% dplyr::count(flag) %>% print()
cat("\n--- Variables flagged for removal ---\n")

variance_summary %>%
  filter(str_detect(flag, "DROP")) %>%
  select(
    Policy_Prov_Code,
    Description,
    n_valid,
    n_unique,
    max_prop_pct,
    flag) %>%
  print()
cat("\n--- Low-variation variables (95–99%) ---\n")

variance_summary %>%
  filter(flag == "95–99% SAME – LOW VAR") %>%
  select(
    Policy_Prov_Code,
    Description,
    n_valid,
    n_unique,
    max_prop_pct,
    flag) %>%
  print()

# Removing zero-variance and near-zero-variance variables
low_variance_vars <- variance_summary %>%
  filter(str_detect(flag, "DROP")) %>%
  pull(Policy_Prov_Code)

agreements_analysis <- agreements_filtered %>%
  select(-any_of(low_variance_vars))

analysis_vars <- setdiff(
  names(agreements_analysis),
  meta_vars)

# Summary
cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("VARIANCE FILTER SUMMARY\n")
cat("==============================\n")
cat("Provision variables before: ",
    length(provision_vars), "\n")

cat("Provision variables removed:",
    length(low_variance_vars), "\n")

cat("Provision variables after:  ",
    length(analysis_vars), "\n")

# Validation
stopifnot(
  length(analysis_vars) ==
    length(provision_vars) - length(low_variance_vars))

# ---- CREATE PROVISION OVERVIEW --------------------------------------------
# Unique observed values for each retained provision

# Summarise unique values for each provision
provision_values <- tibble(
  Policy_Prov_Code = analysis_vars) %>%
  mutate(
    unique_values = sapply(
      analysis_vars,
      function(var) {

        values <- agreements_analysis[[var]]

        values <- trimws(as.character(values))

        values <- values[
          !is.na(values) &
            values != "" &
            values != "NR"]
        paste(
          sort(unique(values)),
          collapse = " | ")}))

# Combine with provision metadata
provision_overview <- provisions_raw %>%
  select(
    `Policy Area`,
    `Sub Area`,
    Policy_Prov_Code,
    Description) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  inner_join(
    provision_values,
    by = "Policy_Prov_Code") %>%
  arrange(
    `Policy Area`,
    `Sub Area`,
    Policy_Prov_Code)

# Validation
stopifnot(
  nrow(provision_overview) ==
    length(analysis_vars))

# ---- CLEAN CHARACTER VARIABLES: Remove hidden whitespace and formatting characters
agreements_analysis <- agreements_analysis %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      where(is.character),
      ~ .x %>%
        stringr::str_replace_all("[\r\n\t]", " ") %>%
        stringr::str_replace_all("\u00A0", " ") %>%
        stringr::str_squish()))

cat("✓ Character variables cleaned.\n")

# ---- IDENTIFY AND EXCLUDE RAW-ZERO AGREEMENTS ---------------------------
pre_recode_data <- agreements_analysis

pre_recode_vars <- setdiff(
  names(pre_recode_data),
  meta_vars)

is_raw_missing <- function(x) {
  x_chr <- stringr::str_squish(as.character(x))
  is.na(x) | x_chr == "" | x_chr == "NR"}

raw_zero_profile <- pre_recode_data %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_missing_raw = sum(
      is_raw_missing(dplyr::c_across(dplyr::all_of(pre_recode_vars)))),
    n_observed_raw = length(pre_recode_vars) - n_missing_raw,

    n_numeric_like_zero_raw = sum(
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(dplyr::c_across(dplyr::all_of(pre_recode_vars)))) == 0,
      na.rm = TRUE),

    n_numeric_like_positive_raw = sum(
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(dplyr::c_across(dplyr::all_of(pre_recode_vars)))) > 0,
      na.rm = TRUE),

    n_non_numeric_observed_raw = sum(
      !is_raw_missing(dplyr::c_across(dplyr::all_of(pre_recode_vars))) &
        is.na(
          suppressWarnings(
            as.numeric(dplyr::c_across(dplyr::all_of(pre_recode_vars)))))),

    raw_sum_numeric_like = sum(
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(dplyr::c_across(dplyr::all_of(pre_recode_vars)))),
      na.rm = TRUE),

    all_observed_numeric_like_zero =
      n_observed_raw > 0 &
      n_numeric_like_positive_raw == 0 &
      n_non_numeric_observed_raw == 0 &
      n_numeric_like_zero_raw == n_observed_raw) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    pct_missing_raw = round(n_missing_raw / length(pre_recode_vars) * 100, 2)) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Agreement,
    RTA_ID,
    Status,
    Date_EIF_G,
    n_observed_raw,
    n_missing_raw,
    pct_missing_raw,
    n_numeric_like_zero_raw,
    n_numeric_like_positive_raw,
    n_non_numeric_observed_raw,
    raw_sum_numeric_like,
    all_observed_numeric_like_zero) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(all_observed_numeric_like_zero),
    dplyr::desc(pct_missing_raw),
    Agreement)

raw_zero_agreements <- raw_zero_profile %>%
  dplyr::filter(all_observed_numeric_like_zero)

raw_zero_ids <- raw_zero_agreements$RTA_ID

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("RAW-ZERO AGREEMENT CHECK\n")
cat("==============================\n")
cat("Agreements before exclusion:", nrow(pre_recode_data), "\n")
cat("Provision variables checked:", length(pre_recode_vars), "\n")
cat("Raw-zero agreements identified:", length(raw_zero_ids), "\n\n")
print(
  raw_zero_agreements %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Agreement,
      RTA_ID,
      Status,
      Date_EIF_G,
      n_observed_raw,
      n_missing_raw,
      pct_missing_raw,
      n_numeric_like_zero_raw,
      n_numeric_like_positive_raw,
      raw_sum_numeric_like),
  n = Inf)

agreements_analysis <- pre_recode_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !RTA_ID %in% raw_zero_ids)

cat("\nAgreements after raw-zero exclusion:", nrow(agreements_analysis), "\n")

stopifnot(
  nrow(agreements_analysis) == nrow(pre_recode_data) - length(raw_zero_ids),
  !any(agreements_analysis$RTA_ID %in% raw_zero_ids))

# ---- FREEZE PRE-RECODING REFERENCE DATASET -------------------------------
agreements_reference <- agreements_analysis

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("REFERENCE DATASET CREATED\n")
cat("==============================\n")
cat("Object created: agreements_reference\n")
cat("Agreements:", nrow(agreements_reference), "\n")
cat("Columns:", ncol(agreements_reference), "\n")

stopifnot(nrow(agreements_reference) == nrow(agreements_analysis))
```

##Reverse coding

```{r reverse-code-binary-provisions}
# ---- REVERSE-CODE BINARY PROVISIONS ----------------------------------------
reverse_vars <- recoding_rules %>%
  filter(code == "R") %>%
  pull(policy_prov_code)

reverse_binary <- function(x) {
  ifelse(
    x == 1,
    0,
    ifelse(
      x == 0,
      1,
      x))
}

for (var in reverse_vars) {

  if (var %in% names(agreements_analysis)) {

    agreements_analysis[[var]] <- reverse_binary(
      agreements_analysis[[var]])
  }
}

cat(
  "Reverse-coded",
  length(reverse_vars),
  "binary provisions.\n")

# ---- VALIDATE REVERSE CODING --------------------------------------------
# Compare selected agreements before and after reverse coding
validation_ids <- c(44, 661, 992)

before_rows <- agreements_reference %>%
  filter(RTA_ID %in% validation_ids)

after_rows <- agreements_analysis %>%
  filter(RTA_ID %in% validation_ids)

for (id in validation_ids) {

  cat("\n========================================\n")
  cat("RTA_ID:", id, "\n")
  cat("========================================\n")

  before_row <- before_rows %>%
    filter(RTA_ID == id)

  after_row <- after_rows %>%
    filter(RTA_ID == id)

  for (var in reverse_vars) {

    if (var %in% names(agreements_analysis)) {

      cat("\nVariable:", var, "\n")
      cat("Before:", before_row[[var]], "\n")
      cat("After: ", after_row[[var]], "\n")

    }
  }
}
```

##Service Provisions

```{r recode-services-other-provisions}
# ----------------------------------------------
# RECODE SERVICES: NATIONAL TREATMENT PROVISIONS
# Shared coding scheme:
# A = 1, B = 0.75, C = 0.50, D = 0.25
# ----------------------------------------------

national_treatment_vars <- c(
  "Services - dr_inf_nat",
  "Services - dr_licdec_nat",
  "Services - dr_mutrec_nat",
  "Services - dr_objec_nat",
  "Services - dr_sinwin_nat",
  "Services - dr_status_nat",
  "Services - trans_app_nat",
  "Services - trans_comm_nat",
  "Services - trans_nat")

# Standardise comma formatting
agreements_analysis <- agreements_analysis %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(national_treatment_vars),
      ~ .x %>%
        stringr::str_squish() %>%
        stringr::str_replace_all("\\s*,\\s*", ",")))

# Letter scores
national_treatment_scores <- c(
  A = 1,
  B = 0.75,
  C = 0.50,
  D = 0.25)

# Recode single letters and letter combinations
recode_national_treatment <- function(x) {

  x <- as.character(x)

  vapply(x, function(value) {

    if (is.na(value) || value == "") {
      return(value)
    }

    # Keep values already coded numerically
    numeric_value <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(value))

    if (!is.na(numeric_value)) {
      return(as.character(numeric_value))
    }

    parts <- strsplit(value, ",", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    parts <- trimws(parts)

    if (all(parts %in% names(national_treatment_scores))) {

      return(
        as.character(
          mean(national_treatment_scores[parts])))
    }
    # Preserve unexpected values exactly as they are
    value
  }, character(1))
}

agreements_analysis <- agreements_analysis %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(national_treatment_vars),
      recode_national_treatment))

# VALIDATE NATIONAL TREATMENT RECODING
for (var in national_treatment_vars) {
  cat("\n========================================\n")
  cat(var, "\n")
  cat("========================================\n")
  print(sort(unique(agreements_analysis[[var]])))
}

# ---- RECODE SERVICES: OTHER PROVISIONS --------------------------------------
# Variable-specific coding schemes

# Standardise formatting for variables containing multiple categories
agreements_analysis <- agreements_analysis %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(
        "Services - othdip_monr",
        "Services - roo_m3",
        "Services - roo_m4"),
      ~ .x %>%
        stringr::str_squish() %>%
        stringr::str_replace_all("\\s*,\\s*", ",") %>%
        stringr::str_replace_all("\\s*;\\s*", ";")))

agreements_analysis <- agreements_analysis %>%
  mutate(
    # Dispute settlement - market access
    `Services - dis_ma` = case_when(
      `Services - dis_ma` == "A" ~ "1",
      `Services - dis_ma` == "B" ~ as.character(2/3),
      `Services - dis_ma` == "C" ~ as.character(1/3),
      TRUE ~ `Services - dis_ma`),

    # Dispute settlement
    `Services - dispute` = case_when(
      `Services - dispute` == "A" ~ as.character(1/3),
      `Services - dispute` == "B" ~ as.character(2/3),
      `Services - dispute` == "C" ~ "1",
      TRUE ~ `Services - dispute`),

    # Domestic regulation
    `Services - dr` = case_when(
      `Services - dr` == "A" ~ "0",
      `Services - dr` == "B" ~ "0.5",
      `Services - dr` == "C" ~ "1",
      TRUE ~ `Services - dr`),

    # Liberalisation approach
    `Services - s_lib_app` = case_when(
      `Services - s_lib_app` == "A" ~ as.character(1/3),
      `Services - s_lib_app` == "B" ~ "1",
      `Services - s_lib_app` == "C" ~ as.character(2/3),
      TRUE ~ `Services - s_lib_app`),

    # Structure
    `Services - struc` = case_when(
      `Services - struc` == "A" ~ as.character(1/3),
      `Services - struc` == "B" ~ as.character(2/3),
      `Services - struc` %in% c("C", "D") ~ "1",
      TRUE ~ `Services - struc`),

    # Monitoring
    `Services - othdip_monr` = case_when(
      `Services - othdip_monr` %in% c("A", "B") ~ "0.5",
      `Services - othdip_monr` %in% c("A,B", "A;B") ~ "1",
      TRUE ~ `Services - othdip_monr`),

    # Exceptions
    `Services - exc` = case_when(
      `Services - exc` == "A" ~ "0",
      TRUE ~ `Services - exc`),

    # Rules of origin (Method 3)
    `Services - roo_m3` = case_when(
      `Services - roo_m3` == "A" ~ as.character(1/6),
      `Services - roo_m3` == "B" ~ as.character(2/6),
      `Services - roo_m3` == "C" ~ as.character(3/6),
      `Services - roo_m3` == "D" ~ as.character(4/6),
      `Services - roo_m3` == "E" ~ as.character(5/6),
      `Services - roo_m3` == "F" ~ "1",
      `Services - roo_m3` == "G" ~ as.character(3.5/6),
      `Services - roo_m3` %in% c("F,G", "D,F") ~ as.character(5/6),
      `Services - roo_m3` == "A,B,C" ~ as.character(2/6),
      TRUE ~ `Services - roo_m3`),

    # Rules of origin (Method 4)
    `Services - roo_m4` = case_when(
      `Services - roo_m4` == "A" ~ "1",
      `Services - roo_m4` == "B" ~ as.character(2/3),
      `Services - roo_m4` == "C" ~ as.character(1/3),
      `Services - roo_m4` %in% c(
        "B,C",
        "B or C",
        "B and C",
        "B for Hong Kong;C for Georgia"
      ) ~ "0.5",
      `Services - roo_m4` == "1" ~ as.character(1/3),
      `Services - roo_m4` == "E" ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ `Services - roo_m4`))

cat("✓ Services provisions recoded.\n")

# ---- VALIDATE SERVICES RECODING --------------------------------------------
service_vars <- c(
  "Services - dis_ma",
  "Services - dispute",
  "Services - dr",
  "Services - s_lib_app",
  "Services - struc",
  "Services - othdip_monr",
  "Services - exc",
  "Services - roo_m3",
  "Services - roo_m4")

for (var in service_vars) {
  cat("\n========================================\n")
  cat(var, "\n")
  cat("========================================\n")
  print(sort(unique(agreements_analysis[[var]])))
}
```

## RoO Provisions

```{r recode-rules-of-origin-provisions}
# ---- RECODE RULES OF ORIGIN PROVISIONS --------------------------------------------
agreements_analysis <- agreements_analysis %>%
  mutate(
    # Certification validity
    `Rules of Origin - roo_cer_val` = case_when(
      `Rules of Origin - roo_cer_val` == "1 year"    ~ "0.25",
      `Rules of Origin - roo_cer_val` == "10 months" ~ "0.75",
      `Rules of Origin - roo_cer_val` == "12 months" ~ "0.75",
      `Rules of Origin - roo_cer_val` == "4 months"  ~ "0.5",
      `Rules of Origin - roo_cer_val` == "180 days"  ~ "0.5",
      `Rules of Origin - roo_cer_val` == "1 to 2"    ~ "0.25",
      `Rules of Origin - roo_cer_val` == "1"         ~ "0.25",
      `Rules of Origin - roo_cer_val` == "4"         ~ "0.5",
      `Rules of Origin - roo_cer_val` == "6"         ~ "0.5",
      `Rules of Origin - roo_cer_val` == "10"        ~ "0.75",
      `Rules of Origin - roo_cer_val` == "12"        ~ "0.75",
      `Rules of Origin - roo_cer_val` %in% c("24", "48") ~ "1",
      TRUE ~ `Rules of Origin - roo_cer_val`),

    # Certificate recognition
    `Rules of Origin - roo_cer_rec` = case_when(
      `Rules of Origin - roo_cer_rec` %in%
        c("2", "2.5", "3", "3 years", "5", "6") ~ "1",
      `Rules of Origin - roo_cer_rec` %in%
        c("4", "4 years", "5 years") ~ as.character(2/3),
      `Rules of Origin - roo_cer_rec` == "7" ~ as.character(1/3),
      TRUE ~ `Rules of Origin - roo_cer_rec`),

    # Cumulation
    `Rules of Origin - roo_cum_dm2` = case_when(
      `Rules of Origin - roo_cum_dm2` %in%
        c("0.1", "10 percent", "1;7;10", "7", "8", "9", "10") ~ "0.5",
      `Rules of Origin - roo_cum_dm2` == "5" ~ "0.25",
      `Rules of Origin - roo_cum_dm2` %in%
        c("10-15%", "15", "15 percent") ~ "1",
      TRUE ~ `Rules of Origin - roo_cum_dm2`),

    # Intermediate materials
    `Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_imc` = case_when(
      `Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_imc` == "10" ~ "1",
      TRUE ~ `Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_imc`),

    # FOB / CIF
    `Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_fnt` = case_when(
      `Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_fnt` == "1"   ~ "0.8",
      `Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_fnt` == "CIF" ~ "0.4",
      `Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_fnt` == "FOB" ~ "1",
      TRUE ~ `Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_fnt`),

    # Price criterion
    `Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_prc` = case_when(
      `Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_prc` == "1" ~ "0.3",
      TRUE ~ `Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_prc`),

    # Duty drawback
    `Rules of Origin - roo_dba` = case_when(
      `Rules of Origin - roo_dba` == "1" ~ "0",
      `Rules of Origin - roo_dba` == "0" ~ "1",
      `Rules of Origin - roo_dba` == "Free Zones" ~ "0.75",
      TRUE ~ `Rules of Origin - roo_dba`),

    # Value content (%)
    `Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_per` = case_when(
      `Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_per` %in% c(
        "See Annex 2 of Protocol",
        "See Annex 2 to Protocol on Rules of Origin and Origin Procedures",
        "See Annex 3-A") ~ NA_character_,
      `Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_per` %in% c("0.1", "10") ~ "0.10",
      `Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_per` %in% c("15") ~ "0.15",
      `Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_per` %in% c("20") ~ "0.20",
      `Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_per` %in% c("25", "25 percent") ~ "0.25",
      `Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_per` %in% c("30") ~ "0.30",
      `Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_per` %in% c("35", "35 percent") ~ "0.35",
      `Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_per` %in% c("40") ~ "0.40",
      `Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_per` %in% c("45") ~ "0.45",
      `Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_per` %in% c("50") ~ "0.50",
      `Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_per` %in% c("55") ~ "0.55",
      `Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_per` %in% c("60") ~ "0.60",
      TRUE ~ `Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_per`),

    # Alternative value content (%)
    `Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_per2` = case_when(
      `Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_per2` == "See Annex 3-A" ~ NA_character_,
      `Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_per2` == "0" ~ "0",
      `Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_per2` == "10" ~ "0.10",
      `Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_per2` == "15" ~ "0.15",
      `Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_per2` %in% c("40", "40 percent", "7; 1") ~ "0.40",
      `Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_per2` == "41.66" ~ "0.4166",
      `Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_per2` == "45 percent" ~ "0.45",
      `Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_per2` == "60" ~ "0.60",
      TRUE ~ `Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_per2`))

cat("✓ Rules of Origin provisions recoded.\n")

# ==========================================================
# VALIDATE RULES OF ORIGIN RECODING
roo_vars <- c(
  "Rules of Origin - roo_cer_val",
  "Rules of Origin - roo_cer_rec",
  "Rules of Origin - roo_cum_dm2",
  "Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_imc",
  "Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_fnt",
  "Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_prc",
  "Rules of Origin - roo_dba",
  "Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_per",
  "Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_per2")

for (var in roo_vars) {
  cat("\n========================================\n")
  cat(var, "\n")
  cat("========================================\n")
  print(sort(unique(agreements_analysis[[var]])))}
```

## Antidumping & Countervailing Duties

```{r recode-antidumping-cvd}
# ---- RECODE ANTIDUMPING & COUNTERVAILING DUTIES PROVISIONS
agreements_analysis <- agreements_analysis %>%
  mutate(
    # Antidumping Duties
    `Antidumping Duties - prov_18` = case_when(
      `Antidumping Duties - prov_18` %in% c("10", "20") ~ "1",
      `Antidumping Duties - prov_18` %in% c("25", "30") ~ as.character(2/3),
      `Antidumping Duties - prov_18` %in% c("60", "90") ~ as.character(1/3),
      TRUE ~ `Antidumping Duties - prov_18`),

    `Antidumping Duties - prov_33` = case_when(
      `Antidumping Duties - prov_33` == "5 years" ~ "0.5",
      TRUE ~ `Antidumping Duties - prov_33`),

    `Antidumping Duties - prov_34` = case_when(
      `Antidumping Duties - prov_34` == "1 - 3 years" ~ "1",
      TRUE ~ `Antidumping Duties - prov_34`),

    `Antidumping Duties - prov_42` = case_when(
      `Antidumping Duties - prov_42` %in% c("5", "7", "10", "90") ~ "1",
      `Antidumping Duties - prov_42` %in% c(
        "15",
        "20",
        "30",
        "15/10",
        "within reaso0ble time frames",
        "as soon as possible") ~ as.character(2/3),
      `Antidumping Duties - prov_42` == "60" ~ as.character(1/3),
      TRUE ~ `Antidumping Duties - prov_42`),

    `Antidumping Duties - prov_45` = case_when(
      `Antidumping Duties - prov_45` == "1" ~ "0.5",
      `Antidumping Duties - prov_45` == "2" ~ "1",
      TRUE ~ `Antidumping Duties - prov_45`),

    # Countervailing Duties
    `Countervailing Duties - prov_09` = case_when(
      `Countervailing Duties - prov_09` == "45" ~ NA_character_,
      `Countervailing Duties - prov_09` == "1" ~ "1",
      `Countervailing Duties - prov_09` == "0" ~ "0",
      TRUE ~ `Countervailing Duties - prov_09`),

    `Countervailing Duties - prov_10` = case_when(
      `Countervailing Duties - prov_10` %in% c("10", "15") ~ "1",
      `Countervailing Duties - prov_10` %in% c("25", "30") ~ as.character(2/3),
      `Countervailing Duties - prov_10` %in% c("45", "60") ~ as.character(1/3),
      TRUE ~ `Countervailing Duties - prov_10`),

    `Countervailing Duties - prov_16` = case_when(
      `Countervailing Duties - prov_16` %in% c("7", "10") ~ as.character(1/3),
      `Countervailing Duties - prov_16` %in% c("15", "20") ~ as.character(2/3),
      `Countervailing Duties - prov_16` %in% c("30", "30 days") ~ "1",
      TRUE ~ `Countervailing Duties - prov_16`),

    `Countervailing Duties - prov_18` = case_when(
      `Countervailing Duties - prov_18` == "1" ~ "0.5",
      `Countervailing Duties - prov_18` == "2" ~ "1",
      TRUE ~ `Countervailing Duties - prov_18`))

cat("✓ Antidumping and Countervailing Duties provisions recoded.\n")
```

Following: Mattoo et al. (2020), Handbook of Deep Trade
Agreements,p.285 Footnote 26.

Import-content methods: Higher percentages = more liberal.
Regional-content methods: Lower required domestic content = more
liberal. Mixed methods: Keep the more liberal option available to
exporters.

```{r identify-roo-value-content-method}
# ---- IDENTIFY ROO VALUE-CONTENT METHOD ----------------------------------
roo_vcr_method <- rep(NA_character_, nrow(agreements_analysis))
# Import-content method
roo_vcr_method[
  agreements_analysis$`Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_imc` == 1] <- "import_content"

# Regional-content method
roo_vcr_method[
  agreements_analysis$`Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_rec` == 1 |
  agreements_analysis$`Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_rbd` == 1 |
  agreements_analysis$`Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_rbu` == 1] <- "regional_content"

# Mixed methods
roo_vcr_method[
  agreements_analysis$`Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_ric` == 1 |
  agreements_analysis$`Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_alt` == 1] <- "mixed"

cat("✓ Value-content methodology identified.\n")
```

Helper Function

```{r roo-value-content-helper}
# ---- HELPER FUNCTION ----------------------------------------------------
adjust_roo_value_content <- function(x, method) {
  idx_rc <- which(method == "regional_content")
  x[idx_rc] <- 1 - x[idx_rc]
  idx_mix <- which(
    method == "mixed" &
      !is.na(x) &
      x < 0.5)
  x[idx_mix] <- 1 - x[idx_mix]
  x
}
```

Recoding

```{r recode-roo-value-content-provisions}
# ---- RECODE ROO VALUE-CONTENT PROVISIONS -------------------------------
agreements_analysis$`Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_per` <- adjust_roo_value_content(
  agreements_analysis$`Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_per`,
  roo_vcr_method)

agreements_analysis$`Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_per2` <- adjust_roo_value_content(
  agreements_analysis$`Rules of Origin - roo_vcr_per2`,
  roo_vcr_method)

cat("✓ RoO value-content provisions recoded.\n")
```

# Final Preprocessing Validation

This section applies final manual corrections, validates the fully
recoded provision-level dataset, and freezes the object used for index
construction. All diagnostics are computed after the final correction
step.

```{r manual-data-correction-sps-provisions}
# ---- MANUAL DATA CORRECTION: SPS PROVISIONS -----------------------------
# Cross-check against the older World Bank SPS coding confirmed that three
# provision values for the CIS agreement require correction.

agreements_analysis <- agreements_analysis %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    `Sanitary and Phytosanitary Measures (SPS) - prov_02` = dplyr::if_else(
      RTA_ID == "99", 1, `Sanitary and Phytosanitary Measures (SPS) - prov_02`),
    `Sanitary and Phytosanitary Measures (SPS) - prov_04` = dplyr::if_else(
      RTA_ID == "99", 0, `Sanitary and Phytosanitary Measures (SPS) - prov_04`),
    `Sanitary and Phytosanitary Measures (SPS) - prov_47` = dplyr::if_else(
      RTA_ID == "99", 1, `Sanitary and Phytosanitary Measures (SPS) - prov_47`))

sps_correction_check <- agreements_analysis %>%
  dplyr::filter(RTA_ID == "99") %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Agreement,
    RTA_ID,
    `Sanitary and Phytosanitary Measures (SPS) - prov_02`,
    `Sanitary and Phytosanitary Measures (SPS) - prov_04`,
    `Sanitary and Phytosanitary Measures (SPS) - prov_47`)

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("MANUAL SPS CORRECTION\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(sps_correction_check)

stopifnot(
  nrow(sps_correction_check) == 1,
  sps_correction_check$`Sanitary and Phytosanitary Measures (SPS) - prov_02` == 1,
  sps_correction_check$`Sanitary and Phytosanitary Measures (SPS) - prov_04` == 0,
  sps_correction_check$`Sanitary and Phytosanitary Measures (SPS) - prov_47` == 1)

# ---- FINAL PREPROCESSING AUDIT ------------------------------------------
# This is the final integrity check before index construction.

provision_vars <- setdiff(names(agreements_analysis), meta_vars)

final_value_audit <- tibble::tibble(
  variable = provision_vars,
  min_value = sapply(agreements_analysis[provision_vars], function(x) suppressWarnings(min(x, na.rm = TRUE))),
  max_value = sapply(agreements_analysis[provision_vars], function(x) suppressWarnings(max(x, na.rm = TRUE))),
  n_missing = sapply(agreements_analysis[provision_vars], function(x) sum(is.na(x))),
  n_unique = sapply(agreements_analysis[provision_vars], dplyr::n_distinct, na.rm = TRUE),
  is_numeric = sapply(agreements_analysis[provision_vars], is.numeric))

final_preprocessing_check <- tibble::tibble(
  agreements = nrow(agreements_analysis),
  total_variables = ncol(agreements_analysis),
  provision_variables = length(provision_vars),
  duplicate_rta_ids = sum(duplicated(agreements_analysis$RTA_ID)),
  missing_rta_ids = sum(is.na(agreements_analysis$RTA_ID)),
  non_numeric_provisions = sum(!final_value_audit$is_numeric),
  suspicious_range_variables = sum(final_value_audit$min_value < 0 | final_value_audit$max_value > 10, na.rm = TRUE),
  zero_variance_provisions = sum(final_value_audit$n_unique <= 1, na.rm = TRUE),
  total_missing_cells = sum(final_value_audit$n_missing))

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("FINAL PREPROCESSING AUDIT\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(final_preprocessing_check)
cat("\nVariables with missing values, sorted descending:\n")

final_value_audit %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_missing > 0) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_missing)) %>%
  print(n = 30)
cat("\nSuspicious provision ranges:\n")

final_value_audit %>%
  dplyr::filter(min_value < 0 | max_value > 10) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(max_value)) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

stopifnot(
  final_preprocessing_check$duplicate_rta_ids == 0,
  final_preprocessing_check$missing_rta_ids == 0,
  final_preprocessing_check$non_numeric_provisions == 0,
  final_preprocessing_check$suspicious_range_variables == 0)

# ---- FREEZE FINAL PREPROCESSING OUTPUT ----------------------------------
# This object is the only valid input for index construction.

agreements_analysis_final <- agreements_analysis

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("FINAL PREPROCESSING DATASET FROZEN\n")
cat("==============================\n")
cat("Object created: agreements_analysis_final\n")
cat("Agreements:", nrow(agreements_analysis_final), "\n")
cat("Provision variables:", length(setdiff(names(agreements_analysis_final), meta_vars)), "\n")

stopifnot(identical(agreements_analysis_final, agreements_analysis))
```

# Index creation

Indices are constructed at the sub-area level. Most indices are
calculated as the arithmetic mean of all provisions in the corresponding
sub-area. A small number of indices containing mutually exclusive
provisions are handled explicitly in later chunks.

```{r reload-updated-provision-mapping}
# ---- RELOAD UPDATED PROVISION MAPPING -----------------------------------
# Reload because sub_area assignments may have been edited manually.

recoding_rules <- readxl::read_excel(
  here::here("provision_unique_values.xlsx")) %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  mutate(
    policy_prov_code = stringr::str_squish(policy_prov_code),
    sub_area = stringr::str_squish(sub_area),
    policy_area = stringr::str_squish(policy_area))

# Quick check
cat("Rows in updated mapping file:", nrow(recoding_rules), "\n")
cat("Unique sub-areas:", dplyr::n_distinct(recoding_rules$sub_area, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Unique policy provision codes:", dplyr::n_distinct(recoding_rules$policy_prov_code), "\n")

# ---- INDEX CREATION SETUP -----------------------------------------------

# Use the frozen final preprocessing dataset as input for index construction
index_input <- agreements_analysis_final

# Provision variables available after all cleaning, recoding, exclusions,
# variance filtering, RoO adjustment, and binary weighting
index_provision_vars <- setdiff(
  names(index_input),
  meta_vars)

# Provision-to-sub-area mapping
index_mapping <- recoding_rules %>%
  dplyr::select(
    policy_area,
    sub_area,
    policy_prov_code) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    policy_area = stringr::str_squish(policy_area),
    sub_area = stringr::str_squish(sub_area),
    policy_prov_code = stringr::str_squish(policy_prov_code)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    policy_prov_code %in% index_provision_vars,
    !is.na(sub_area),
    sub_area != "") %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

# Check whether any final provision variable has no sub-area mapping
unmapped_index_vars <- setdiff(
  index_provision_vars,
  index_mapping$policy_prov_code)

# Check whether any provision is assigned to more than one sub-area
duplicate_mappings <- index_mapping %>%
  dplyr::count(policy_prov_code, name = "n_mappings") %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_mappings > 1)

# Check whether the same sub-area label appears under multiple policy areas
subarea_policy_check <- index_mapping %>%
  dplyr::distinct(policy_area, sub_area) %>%
  dplyr::count(sub_area, name = "n_policy_areas") %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_policy_areas > 1)

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("INDEX CREATION SETUP\n")
cat("==============================\n")
cat("Agreements:", nrow(index_input), "\n")
cat("Provision variables in final dataset:", length(index_provision_vars), "\n")
cat("Mapped provisions used for indexing:", nrow(index_mapping), "\n")
cat("Sub-area indices to create:", dplyr::n_distinct(index_mapping$sub_area), "\n")

if (length(unmapped_index_vars) == 0) {
  cat("✓ All final provision variables are mapped to a sub-area.\n")} else {
  cat("WARNING: Some final provision variables are not mapped:\n")
  print(unmapped_index_vars)}

if (nrow(duplicate_mappings) == 0) {
  cat("✓ No provision is assigned to more than one sub-area.\n")} else {
  cat("WARNING: Some provisions are assigned to multiple sub-areas:\n")

if (nrow(subarea_policy_check) == 0) {
  cat("✓ Each sub-area label belongs to only one policy area.\n")} else {
  cat("WARNING: Some sub-area labels appear under multiple policy areas:\n")
  print(subarea_policy_check)}

# Hard checks
stopifnot(
  nrow(index_input) == nrow(agreements_analysis_final),
  length(unmapped_index_vars) == 0,
  nrow(duplicate_mappings) == 0,
  nrow(subarea_policy_check) == 0)

# ---- CONSTRUCT SUB-AREA INDEX GROUPS ------------------------------------
index_groups <- index_mapping %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    policy_area,

  dplyr::summarise(
    provisions = list(policy_prov_code),

    .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    index_name = sub_area) %>%

# Check whether index names are unique
```

## Special indices

```{r define-special-indices}
# ---- DEFINE SPECIAL INDICES ---------------------------------------------

special_index_names <- special_index_denominators$index_name

special_index_groups <- index_groups %>%

  print(missing_special_indices)}
print(special_index_denominators)

stopifnot(length(missing_special_indices) == 0)

# ---- AUDIT MISSINGNESS IN SPECIAL INDICES -------------------------------
special_index_row_audit <- purrr::map_dfr(
  special_index_groups$index_name,
  function(current_index) {

      all_missing = n_observed == 0,

special_index_missing_summary <- special_index_row_audit %>%

# In the current dataset, partial missingness is expected only for RoO_value_content due to missing roo_vcr_per / roo_vcr_per2 values.
unexpected_partial_missing <- special_partial_missing_cases %>%
  dplyr::filter(index_name != "RoO_value_content")

if (nrow(unexpected_partial_missing) == 0) {
```

## Computing indices

Most sub-area indices are calculated as the arithmetic mean of their
underlying provision-level scores. Special indices are calculated here
mechanically first and overwritten in the next chunk using theoretical
maximum scores.

```{r compute-sub-area-indices}
# ---- COMPUTE SUB-AREA INDICES -------------------------------------------
compute_subarea_index <- function(data, vars) {
  temp <- data[, vars, drop = FALSE]
  denominator <- rowSums(!is.na(temp))
  numerator <- rowSums(temp, na.rm = TRUE)

  index_value <- numerator / denominator
  index_value[denominator == 0] <- NA_real_
  index_value}

# Start index dataset with metadata only
index_scores <- index_input %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(meta_vars))

# Create one index column per sub-area
for (i in seq_len(nrow(index_groups))) {
  index_name <- index_groups$index_name[i]
  provisions <- index_groups$provisions[[i]]
  index_scores[[index_name]] <- compute_subarea_index(
    data = index_input,
    vars = provisions)}

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("SUB-AREA INDICES CREATED\n")
cat("==============================\n")
cat("Agreements:", nrow(index_scores), "\n")
cat("Metadata variables:", length(meta_vars), "\n")
cat("Sub-area index variables:", ncol(index_scores) - length(meta_vars), "\n")

stopifnot(
  nrow(index_scores) == nrow(index_input),
  ncol(index_scores) - length(meta_vars) == nrow(index_groups))

# ---- OVERWRITE SPECIAL INDICES ------------------------------------------
# These indices are not calculated as simple arithmetic means.
# Instead, they are normalized by their theoretical maximum score.

stopifnot(exists("special_index_denominators"))
stopifnot(exists("index_scores"))
stopifnot(exists("index_groups"))
stopifnot(exists("index_input"))

# Helper: extract provision variables for one index
get_index_vars <- function(index_name_value) {
  index_groups %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$index_name == index_name_value) %>%
    dplyr::pull(provisions) %>%
    .[[1]]}

# Helper: calculate special index
calculate_special_index <- function(data, vars, theoretical_max_score) {

  temp <- data[, vars, drop = FALSE]

  n_observed <- rowSums(!is.na(temp))
  n_missing <- rowSums(is.na(temp))

  raw_score <- rowSums(temp, na.rm = TRUE)
  index_value <- raw_score / theoretical_max_score

  # If all provisions are missing, the index is missing.
  index_value[n_observed == 0] <- NA_real_

  # If some, but not all, provisions are missing, keep the index missing.
  # This avoids treating real missing values as zero.
  index_value[n_missing > 0 & n_observed > 0] <- NA_real_

  index_value}

# Check that all special indices exist in index_groups
missing_special_indices <- setdiff(
  special_index_denominators$index_name,
  index_groups$index_name)

if (length(missing_special_indices) == 0) {
  cat("✓ All special indices found in index_groups.\n")} else {
  cat("WARNING: Missing special indices:\n")
  print(missing_special_indices)}

stopifnot(length(missing_special_indices) == 0)

# Safe max helper for audit table
safe_max <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x))) {
    return(NA_real_)} else {
    return(max(x, na.rm = TRUE))}}

# Overwrite special indices
special_index_audit <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(special_index_denominators))) {

  current_index <- special_index_denominators$index_name[i]
  current_max <- special_index_denominators$theoretical_max_score[i]
  current_vars <- get_index_vars(current_index)

  temp <- index_input[, current_vars, drop = FALSE]

  n_observed <- rowSums(!is.na(temp))
  n_missing <- rowSums(is.na(temp))
  raw_score <- rowSums(temp, na.rm = TRUE)

  index_scores[[current_index]] <- calculate_special_index(
    data = index_input,
    vars = current_vars,
    theoretical_max_score = current_max)

  special_index_audit[[current_index]] <- tibble::tibble(
    index_name = current_index,
    theoretical_max_score = current_max,
    n_dataset_provisions = length(current_vars),
    complete_rows = sum(n_missing == 0),
    all_missing_rows = sum(n_observed == 0),
    partial_missing_rows = sum(n_missing > 0 & n_observed > 0),
    max_raw_score_observed_complete_rows = safe_max(raw_score[n_missing == 0]),
    max_index_observed = safe_max(index_scores[[current_index]]))}

special_index_audit <- dplyr::bind_rows(special_index_audit)

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("SPECIAL INDICES OVERWRITTEN\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(special_index_audit, n = Inf)

# Final range check for special indices
special_index_range_problem <- special_index_audit %>%
  dplyr::filter(max_index_observed > 1)

if (nrow(special_index_range_problem) == 0) {
  cat("✓ All special indices are within [0, 1].\n")} else {
  cat("WARNING: Some special indices exceed 1. Inspect denominator logic:\n")
  print(special_index_range_problem)}

stopifnot(nrow(special_index_range_problem) == 0)
```

## Adjusted RoO value

Three agreements have real missing values only in roo_vcr_per /
roo_vcr_per2. For these cases, RoO_value_content is manually calculated
with an adjusted denominator reflecting the observed value-content
components.

```{r manual-adjustment-roo-value-content-partial-missing-cases}
# ---- MANUAL ADJUSTMENT: ROO VALUE-CONTENT PARTIAL MISSING CASES ---------
roo_value_content_manual_adjustments <- tibble::tribble(
  ~RTA_ID, ~Agreement,                               ~adjusted_denominator, ~expected_missing,
  "1091",  "United Kingdom - Japan",                 5,                     2,
  "1113",  "United Kingdom - Korea, Republic of",     6,                     1,
  "1129",  "United Kingdom - Türkiye",               6,                     1)

roo_value_content_vars <- get_index_vars("RoO_value_content")

roo_manual_scores <- index_input %>%
  dplyr::filter(RTA_ID %in% roo_value_content_manual_adjustments$RTA_ID) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Agreement,
    RTA_ID,
    dplyr::all_of(roo_value_content_vars)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    roo_value_content_manual_adjustments %>%
      dplyr::select(RTA_ID, adjusted_denominator, expected_missing),
    by = "RTA_ID") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_missing = rowSums(is.na(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(roo_value_content_vars)))),
    raw_score = rowSums(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(roo_value_content_vars)), na.rm = TRUE),
    manual_RoO_value_content = raw_score / adjusted_denominator)

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("MANUAL ROO VALUE-CONTENT ADJUSTMENT\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(
  roo_manual_scores %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Agreement,
      RTA_ID,
      n_missing,
      expected_missing,
      raw_score,
      adjusted_denominator,
      manual_RoO_value_content),
  n = Inf)

# Check that the missingness matches the manual decision
stopifnot(
  all(roo_manual_scores$n_missing == roo_manual_scores$expected_missing))

# Apply manual adjustment
index_scores$RoO_value_content[
  match(roo_manual_scores$RTA_ID, index_scores$RTA_ID)
] <- roo_manual_scores$manual_RoO_value_content

cat("✓ Manual RoO_value_content adjustment applied to 3 agreements.\n")
```

```{r validate-final-index-dataset}
  tidyr::pivot_longer(

    names_to = "index_name",
    values_to = "index_value") %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.na(index_value)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    index_groups %>%
      dplyr::select(
        policy_area,
        sub_area,
        index_name,
        n_provisions),
    by = "index_name") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    Agreement,
    policy_area,
    sub_area)

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("MISSING INDEX DETAILS BY AGREEMENT\n")
cat("==============================\n")

agreement_missing_index_details %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Agreement,
    RTA_ID,
    index_name,
    n_provisions) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

# Descriptive Architecture Analysis

This section describes the agreement-level architecture dataset
before architecture-family analysis. It documents the distribution, variance, and
missingness of the 116 sub-area indices.

```{r descriptive-architecture-analysis, include=FALSE}
# ---- DESCRIPTIVE ARCHITECTURE ANALYSIS ----------------------------------

index_vars <- setdiff(names(index_scores_final), meta_vars)

index_scores_long <- index_scores_final %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(meta_vars), dplyr::all_of(index_vars)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::all_of(index_vars),
    names_to = "index_name",
    values_to = "index_value") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    index_groups %>%
      dplyr::select(policy_area, sub_area, index_name, n_provisions),
    by = "index_name")

index_summary <- index_scores_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(policy_area, sub_area, index_name, n_provisions) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_agreements = dplyr::n(),
    n_non_missing = sum(!is.na(index_value)),
    missing = sum(is.na(index_value)),
    missing_pct = round(mean(is.na(index_value)) * 100, 2),
    mean_index = mean(index_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_index = stats::sd(index_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_index = min(index_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_index = max(index_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(policy_area, sub_area)

agreement_architecture_summary <- index_scores_final %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_missing_indices = rowSums(is.na(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(index_vars)))),
    architecture_mean = rowMeans(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(index_vars)), na.rm = TRUE),
    architecture_sum = rowSums(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(index_vars)), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Agreement, RTA_ID, Status, Date_EIF_G, n_missing_indices, architecture_mean, architecture_sum) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(architecture_sum))

most_variable_indices <- index_summary %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(sd_index)) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 20)

least_variable_indices <- index_summary %>%
  dplyr::arrange(sd_index) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 20)

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("DESCRIPTIVE ARCHITECTURE ANALYSIS\n")
cat("==============================\n")
cat("Agreements:", nrow(index_scores_final), "\n")
cat("Index variables:", length(index_vars), "\n")
cat("Complete agreement architecture vectors:", sum(agreement_architecture_summary$n_missing_indices == 0), "\n")
cat("Incomplete agreement architecture vectors:", sum(agreement_architecture_summary$n_missing_indices > 0), "\n")
cat("Total missing index cells:", sum(is.na(index_scores_final[index_vars])), "\n")
cat("\nMost variable indices:\n")
print(most_variable_indices, n = 20)
cat("\nLeast variable indices:\n")
print(least_variable_indices, n = 20)

stopifnot(
  nrow(index_scores_long) == nrow(index_scores_final) * length(index_vars),
  nrow(index_summary) == length(index_vars))
```

# Correlation and Redundancy Check

This section examines whether the 116 sub-area architecture indices
contain substantial redundancy. The purpose is not to remove variables
automatically, but to understand whether some indices move closely
together before architecture-family and regression analysis.
Correlated indices may reflect meaningful institutional bundles.

```{r correlation-redundancy-setup, include=FALSE}
# ---- CORRELATION / REDUNDANCY SETUP -------------------------------------

index_vars <- setdiff(names(index_scores_final), meta_vars)

index_metadata <- index_groups %>%
  dplyr::select(policy_area, sub_area, index_name, n_provisions) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

index_corr_sample <- index_scores_final %>%
  dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(index_vars))))

index_corr_data <- index_corr_sample %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(index_vars))

zero_variance_indices <- index_corr_data %>%
  dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), ~ stats::sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = dplyr::everything(), names_to = "index_name", values_to = "sd_index") %>%
  dplyr::filter(sd_index == 0 | is.na(sd_index))

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("CORRELATION / REDUNDANCY SETUP\n")
cat("==============================\n")
cat("Full index dataset:", nrow(index_scores_final), "agreements\n")
cat("Complete-case correlation sample:", nrow(index_corr_sample), "agreements\n")
cat("Index variables:", length(index_vars), "\n")
cat("Missing values in input:", sum(is.na(index_corr_data)), "\n")
cat("Zero-variance indices:", nrow(zero_variance_indices), "\n")

stopifnot(
  nrow(index_corr_sample) > 0,
  ncol(index_corr_data) == length(index_vars),
  sum(is.na(index_corr_data)) == 0,
  nrow(zero_variance_indices) == 0)

# ---- CALCULATE INDEX CORRELATIONS ---------------------------------------

index_cor_pearson <- stats::cor(index_corr_data, method = "pearson", use = "complete.obs")
index_cor_spearman <- stats::cor(index_corr_data, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("INDEX CORRELATION MATRICES\n")
cat("==============================\n")
cat("Pearson dimensions:", nrow(index_cor_pearson), "x", ncol(index_cor_pearson), "\n")
cat("Spearman dimensions:", nrow(index_cor_spearman), "x", ncol(index_cor_spearman), "\n")

stopifnot(
  nrow(index_cor_pearson) == length(index_vars),
  ncol(index_cor_pearson) == length(index_vars),
  !any(is.na(index_cor_pearson)),
  !any(is.na(index_cor_spearman)))

# ---- IDENTIFY HIGHLY CORRELATED INDEX PAIRS -----------------------------

index_cor_long <- as.data.frame(as.table(index_cor_pearson), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::rename(index_1 = Var1, index_2 = Var2, correlation = Freq) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    index_1_order = match(index_1, index_vars),
    index_2_order = match(index_2, index_vars)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(index_1_order < index_2_order) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(abs_correlation = abs(correlation)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(index_metadata %>% dplyr::rename(index_1 = index_name, policy_area_1 = policy_area, sub_area_1 = sub_area), by = "index_1") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(index_metadata %>% dplyr::rename(index_2 = index_name, policy_area_2 = policy_area, sub_area_2 = sub_area), by = "index_2") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(same_policy_area = policy_area_1 == policy_area_2) %>%
  dplyr::select(index_1, policy_area_1, index_2, policy_area_2, correlation, abs_correlation, same_policy_area) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(abs_correlation))

high_corr_pairs_80 <- index_cor_long %>% dplyr::filter(abs_correlation >= 0.80)
high_corr_pairs_90 <- index_cor_long %>% dplyr::filter(abs_correlation >= 0.90)

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("HIGH-CORRELATION INDEX PAIRS\n")
cat("==============================\n")
cat("Total pairwise correlations:", nrow(index_cor_long), "\n")
cat("Pairs with |correlation| >= 0.80:", nrow(high_corr_pairs_80), "\n")
cat("Pairs with |correlation| >= 0.90:", nrow(high_corr_pairs_90), "\n")
cat("\nTop 30 correlated index pairs:\n")

index_cor_long %>%
  dplyr::mutate(correlation = round(correlation, 3), abs_correlation = round(abs_correlation, 3)) %>% head(30) %>%
  print()

# ---- INDEX-LEVEL REDUNDANCY SUMMARY -------------------------------------

index_redundancy_summary <- purrr::map_dfr(index_vars, function(current_index) {
  current_correlations <- index_cor_pearson[current_index, setdiff(index_vars, current_index)]
  strongest_partner <- names(which.max(abs(current_correlations)))
  tibble::tibble(
    index_name = current_index,
    max_abs_correlation = max(abs(current_correlations), na.rm = TRUE),
    strongest_correlated_index = strongest_partner,
    strongest_correlation = current_correlations[strongest_partner],
    mean_abs_correlation = mean(abs(current_correlations), na.rm = TRUE),
    n_correlations_ge_80 = sum(abs(current_correlations) >= 0.80, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_correlations_ge_90 = sum(abs(current_correlations) >= 0.90, na.rm = TRUE))}) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(index_metadata, by = "index_name") %>%
  dplyr::select(policy_area, sub_area, index_name, n_provisions, max_abs_correlation,
                strongest_correlated_index, strongest_correlation, mean_abs_correlation,
                n_correlations_ge_80, n_correlations_ge_90) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    max_abs_correlation = round(max_abs_correlation, 3),
    strongest_correlation = round(strongest_correlation, 3),
    mean_abs_correlation = round(mean_abs_correlation, 3)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(max_abs_correlation), dplyr::desc(n_correlations_ge_80))

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("INDEX-LEVEL REDUNDANCY SUMMARY\n")
cat("==============================\n")
cat("Indices with at least one |correlation| >= 0.80:", sum(index_redundancy_summary$n_correlations_ge_80 > 0), "\n")
cat("Indices with at least one |correlation| >= 0.90:", sum(index_redundancy_summary$n_correlations_ge_90 > 0), "\n")
cat("\nMost redundant indices:\n")
print(index_redundancy_summary, n = 30)

# ---- POLICY-AREA CORRELATION CHECK ---------------------------------------
# This diagnostic aggregates the 116 sub-area indices to policy-area means.
# It is used only to inspect broad redundancy patterns across policy areas.
# The main analysis remains at the sub-area index level.

policy_area_corr_index_vars <- setdiff(
  names(index_scores_final),
  c("Agreement", "RTA_ID", "WB_ID", "Status", "Date_EIF_G"))

policy_area_index_map <- index_groups %>%
  dplyr::select(policy_area, index_name) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::filter(index_name %in% policy_area_corr_index_vars)

missing_policy_area_metadata <- tibble::tibble(index_name = policy_area_corr_index_vars) %>%
  dplyr::anti_join(policy_area_index_map, by = "index_name")

stopifnot(nrow(missing_policy_area_metadata) == 0)

policy_area_corr_wide <- index_scores_final %>%
  dplyr::filter(RTA_ID %in% index_corr_sample$RTA_ID) %>%
  dplyr::select(Agreement, RTA_ID, dplyr::all_of(policy_area_corr_index_vars)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::all_of(policy_area_corr_index_vars),
    names_to = "index_name",
    values_to = "index_value") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(policy_area_index_map, by = "index_name") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Agreement, RTA_ID, policy_area) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(policy_area_score = mean(index_value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = policy_area, values_from = policy_area_score)

policy_area_corr_vars <- setdiff(names(policy_area_corr_wide), c("Agreement", "RTA_ID"))
policy_area_corr_data <- policy_area_corr_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(policy_area_corr_vars))

policy_area_cor_matrix <- stats::cor(policy_area_corr_data, method = "pearson", use = "complete.obs")

policy_area_cor_long <- as.data.frame(as.table(policy_area_cor_matrix), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  tibble::as_tibble() %>%
  dplyr::rename(policy_area_1 = Var1, policy_area_2 = Var2, correlation = Freq) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    area_1_order = match(policy_area_1, policy_area_corr_vars),
    area_2_order = match(policy_area_2, policy_area_corr_vars),
    abs_correlation = abs(correlation)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(area_1_order < area_2_order) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(abs_correlation))

high_corr_policy_pattern <- high_corr_pairs_80 %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    high_corr_pairs = dplyr::n(),
    within_policy_area_pairs = sum(same_policy_area),
    cross_policy_area_pairs = sum(!same_policy_area),
    within_policy_area_pct = round(mean(same_policy_area) * 100, 2),
    cross_policy_area_pct = round(mean(!same_policy_area) * 100, 2))

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("POLICY-AREA CORRELATION CHECK\n")
cat("==============================\n")
cat("Policy areas included:", ncol(policy_area_cor_matrix), "\n")
cat("Policy-area pairs:", nrow(policy_area_cor_long), "\n")
print(high_corr_policy_pattern)
cat("Top policy-area correlations:\n")

policy_area_cor_long %>%
  dplyr::mutate(correlation = round(correlation, 3), abs_correlation = round(abs_correlation, 3)) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

stopifnot(
  ncol(policy_area_cor_matrix) == length(policy_area_corr_vars),
  nrow(policy_area_cor_long) == choose(length(policy_area_corr_vars), 2))

```

# Ward-Linkage Architecture Family Analysis

This section identifies empirically compact architecture families of trade agreements from their complete 116-index institutional profiles. Each agreement is treated as a vector of sub-area index scores and grouped with agreements that are similar across the full architecture profile.

Ward linkage is used because the aim is to obtain compact and
interpretable agreement families. The method is applied to Euclidean
distances, which is the appropriate distance geometry for Ward.D2. Since
all index variables are already scaled between 0 and 1, no further
standardisation is applied.

```{r prepare-ward-clustering-input}
# ---- PREPARE WARD CLUSTERING INPUT ----------------------------------------
# This section prepares the agreement-by-index matrix for Ward hierarchical
# clustering. The clustering is based on the final 116 sub-area indices.

ward_meta_vars <- c("Agreement", "RTA_ID", "WB_ID", "Status", "Date_EIF_G")

ward_index_vars <- if (exists("index_vars")) {
  index_vars
} else {
  setdiff(names(index_scores_final), ward_meta_vars)
}

ward_index_vars <- setdiff(ward_index_vars, "Unnamed: 0")

ward_input <- index_scores_final %>%
  dplyr::mutate(RTA_ID = as.character(RTA_ID)) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    dplyr::all_of(ward_meta_vars),
    dplyr::all_of(ward_index_vars)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(ward_index_vars), as.numeric))

ward_complete_data <- ward_input %>%
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::if_all(dplyr::all_of(ward_index_vars), ~ !is.na(.x)))

ward_meta <- ward_complete_data %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(ward_meta_vars))

ward_matrix <- ward_complete_data %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(ward_index_vars)) %>%
  as.matrix()

rownames(ward_matrix) <- ward_meta$RTA_ID
storage.mode(ward_matrix) <- "double"

ward_input_check <- tibble::tibble(
  full_agreements = nrow(ward_input),
  clustered_agreements = nrow(ward_matrix),
  excluded_incomplete_agreements = nrow(ward_input) - nrow(ward_matrix),
  index_variables = ncol(ward_matrix),
  missing_cells = sum(is.na(ward_matrix)),
  min_value = min(ward_matrix),
  max_value = max(ward_matrix),
  zero_variance_indices = sum(apply(ward_matrix, 2, stats::sd) == 0),
  duplicate_rta_ids = sum(duplicated(rownames(ward_matrix))))

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("WARD CLUSTERING INPUT\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(ward_input_check)

sample_flow <- tibble::tibble(
  stage = c(
    "Matched to bilateral information",
    "After coding exclusions",
    "After raw-zero exclusion",
    "Complete 116-index Ward sample"),
  agreements = c(
    nrow(agreements_matched),
    nrow(agreements_filtered),
    nrow(agreements_analysis_final),
    nrow(ward_matrix))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(removed_from_previous = dplyr::lag(agreements) - agreements)

table_1_sample_construction <- sample_flow %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Stage = dplyr::case_when(
      stage == "Matched to bilateral information" ~
        "Matched to Bilateral Information",
      stage == "After raw-zero exclusion" ~
        "After zero-profile exclusion",
      stage == "Complete 116-index Ward sample" ~
        "Complete 116-index clustering sample",
      TRUE ~ stage),
    Agreements = agreements,
    Removed = removed_from_previous)

table_1_sample_construction_display <-
  table_1_sample_construction %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Removed = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(Removed),
      "—",
      as.character(Removed)))

dir.create(
  here::here("output"),
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE)

readr::write_csv(
  table_1_sample_construction,
  here::here(
    "output",
    "Table_1_agreement_sample_construction.csv"))

cat("\nSequential agreement sample flow:\n")
print(sample_flow, n = Inf)

knitr::kable(
  table_1_sample_construction_display,
  align = c("l", "r", "r"),
  caption = "Table 1. Agreement sample construction")

stopifnot(
  nrow(ward_matrix) > 0,
  ncol(ward_matrix) == 116,
  sum(is.na(ward_matrix)) == 0,
  all(ward_matrix >= 0),
  all(ward_matrix <= 1),
  sum(apply(ward_matrix, 2, stats::sd) == 0) == 0,
  sum(duplicated(rownames(ward_matrix))) == 0)
```

## Ward hierarchical clustering

```{r ward-hierarchical-clustering, include=FALSE}
# ---- WARD HIERARCHICAL CLUSTERING -----------------------------------------
# Ward.D2 is used with Euclidean distance. Since all indices are scaled 0-1,
# agreements are compared across their full 116-index architecture profiles.

ward_distance <- stats::dist(
  ward_matrix,
  method = "euclidean")

ward_hclust <- stats::hclust(
  ward_distance,
  method = "ward.D2")

plot(
  ward_hclust,
  labels = FALSE,
  hang = -1,
  main = "Ward hierarchical clustering of agreement architecture",
  xlab = "Agreements",
  ylab = "Ward linkage height")
```

## Candidate family solutions

The number of retained architecture families is not selected
mechanically from a single statistic. Silhouette values are used as a
diagnostic only, because high-dimensional institutional data are
unlikely to produce sharply separated clusters. The final solution is
selected by combining cluster-size distribution, absence of singleton
clusters, dendrogram structure, and substantive interpretability of the
resulting family profiles.

```{r inspect-ward-family-solutions}
# ---- INSPECT WARD FAMILY SOLUTIONS ----------------------------------------
# Silhouette is used as a diagnostic only. The final number of families should
# be chosen based on family sizes, dendrogram structure, and substantive
# interpretability.

ward_k_diagnostics <- purrr::map_dfr(5:12, function(k_value) {

  ward_clusters_k <- stats::cutree(ward_hclust, k = k_value)
  cluster_sizes <- sort(table(ward_clusters_k), decreasing = TRUE)

  silhouette_result <- cluster::silhouette(
    ward_clusters_k,
    ward_distance)

  tibble::tibble(
    k = k_value,
    largest_family = as.integer(cluster_sizes[1]),
    second_largest_family = as.integer(cluster_sizes[2]),
    smallest_family = as.integer(min(cluster_sizes)),
    singleton_families = sum(cluster_sizes == 1),
    mean_silhouette = round(mean(silhouette_result[, "sil_width"]), 4))})

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("WARD FAMILY SOLUTION DIAGNOSTICS\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(ward_k_diagnostics)
```

## Final nine-family solution

The nine-family solution is retained as the main architecture-family
solution. This choice is not based on the silhouette score alone. Across
the inspected candidate solutions, silhouette values remain low, which
is expected in a high-dimensional institutional setting where agreements
differ gradually rather than forming perfectly separated legal
categories. The nine-family solution is retained because it produces no
singleton families, keeps all families large enough for interpretation,
and yields substantively coherent institutional profiles. More
parsimonious solutions merge profiles that are substantively distinct,
while more granular solutions add complexity without a clear gain in
interpretability.

```{r create-final-ward-architecture-families}
# ---- CREATE FINAL WARD ARCHITECTURE FAMILIES ------------------------------
ward_k_final <- 9

ward_clusters <- stats::cutree(
  ward_hclust,
  k = ward_k_final)

architecture_families_final <- ward_meta %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    architecture_family_id = as.integer(ward_clusters),
    architecture_family = paste0("family_", architecture_family_id))

architecture_family_summary <- architecture_families_final %>%
  dplyr::count(
    architecture_family_id,
    architecture_family,
    name = "agreements") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    share = round(agreements / sum(agreements), 3)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(agreements))

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("FINAL WARD ARCHITECTURE FAMILIES\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(architecture_family_summary)
```

## Distinctive index profiles

Family labels are based on indices where each family scores above the
sample mean. This is preferable to labelling families by their highest
raw index scores, because some indices are high across many agreements
and therefore do not distinguish one family from the rest of the
sample.

```{r distinctive-indices-by-ward-family}
# ---- DISTINCTIVE INDICES BY WARD FAMILY -----------------------------------
# Family labels are based on indices where a family scores above the sample
# mean, not only on the indices with the highest absolute family means.

ward_full <- ward_complete_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    architecture_family_id = as.integer(ward_clusters),
    architecture_family = paste0("family_", architecture_family_id))

overall_index_means <- ward_full %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(ward_index_vars),
      ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::everything(),
    names_to = "index_name",
    values_to = "overall_mean")

ward_family_profiles <- ward_full %>%
  dplyr::group_by(architecture_family_id, architecture_family) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    agreements = dplyr::n(),
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(ward_index_vars),
      ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop")

ward_family_distinctive_indices <- ward_family_profiles %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::all_of(ward_index_vars),
    names_to = "index_name",
    values_to = "family_mean") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(overall_index_means, by = "index_name") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    deviation_from_sample = family_mean - overall_mean) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    architecture_family_id,
    dplyr::desc(deviation_from_sample))

ward_family_top_indices <- ward_family_distinctive_indices %>%
  dplyr::group_by(architecture_family_id, architecture_family, agreements) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(
    order_by = deviation_from_sample,
    n = 10,
    with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    architecture_family_id,
    dplyr::desc(deviation_from_sample))

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("TOP DISTINCTIVE INDICES BY WARD FAMILY\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(ward_family_top_indices, n = Inf)
```

## Final architecture-family labels

The labels below are assigned after jointly inspecting three sources
of evidence: the distinctive index profiles, the agreement membership of
each family, and agreement-level heatmaps. The labels should therefore
be interpreted as concise descriptions of empirically compact agreement
profiles, not as formal legal categories.

```{r label-final-ward-architecture-families}
# ---- LABEL FINAL WARD ARCHITECTURE FAMILIES --------------------------------

architecture_family_labels <- tibble::tibble(
  architecture_family_id = 1:9,
  architecture_family_label = c(
    "Trade Facilitation and Regulatory Governance Architecture",
    "Minimalist Institutional Architecture",
    "Services, Competition and Mobility Governance Architecture",
    "Services–Investment and Capital Mobility Architecture",
    "Preferential Goods-Trade Administration Architecture",
    "Comprehensive Market-Access and Enforcement Architecture",
    "Public Procurement Governance Architecture",
    "Export Liberalisation and Regulatory Compatibility Architecture",
    "Sustainable-Development and Regulatory Integration Architecture"),
  architecture_family_short = c(
    "trade_facilitation_regulatory_governance",
    "minimalist_institutional",
    "services_competition_mobility_governance",
    "services_investment_capital_mobility",
    "preferential_goods_trade_administration",
    "comprehensive_market_access_enforcement",
    "public_procurement_governance",
    "export_liberalisation_regulatory_compatibility",
    "sustainable_development_regulatory_integration"))

architecture_families_final <- architecture_families_final %>%
  dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of("architecture_family_label")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(architecture_family_labels, by = "architecture_family_id")

architecture_family_summary_labeled <- architecture_families_final %>%
  dplyr::count(architecture_family_id, architecture_family, architecture_family_label,
               architecture_family_short, name = "agreements") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(share = round(agreements / sum(agreements), 3)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(agreements))

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("LABELED WARD ARCHITECTURE FAMILIES\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(architecture_family_summary_labeled, n = Inf)

# ---- ARCHITECTURE LABEL PROFILE SANITY CHECK -------------------------------

label_profile_sanity_check <- ward_family_distinctive_indices %>%
  dplyr::left_join(architecture_family_labels, by = "architecture_family_id") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(architecture_family_id, architecture_family_label) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(deviation_from_sample), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 8) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(
    architecture_family_id,
    architecture_family_label,
    index_name,
    family_mean,
    overall_mean,
    deviation_from_sample)

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("ARCHITECTURE LABEL PROFILE SANITY CHECK\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(label_profile_sanity_check, n = Inf, width = Inf)

table_2_leading_distinctions <- ward_family_top_indices %>%
  dplyr::group_by(architecture_family_id) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(deviation_from_sample),
    .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 3) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    leading_distinguishing_sub_areas = paste(
      index_name,
      collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop")

table_2_architecture_families <-
  architecture_family_summary_labeled %>%

    `Architecture family` = architecture_family_label,

      leading_distinguishing_sub_areas)

dir.create(

readr::write_csv(

    "output",

knitr::kable(

  align = c("r", "l", "r", "l"),
  caption = paste(
    "Table 2. Distribution and leading distinctions",
```

## Cluster-solution sensitivity

This diagnostic checks how the retained nine-family solution relates
to adjacent Ward solutions. It is used as a robustness and transparency
check, not as a mechanical rule for selecting k.

```{r ward-solution-sensitivity}
# ---- WARD SOLUTION SENSITIVITY --------------------------------------------

ward_solution_sensitivity <- ward_k_diagnostics %>%
  dplyr::filter(k %in% c(8, 9, 10)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(k)

ward_solution_crosswalk <- purrr::map_dfr(c(8, 10), function(k_compare) {
  tibble::tibble(
    Agreement = rownames(ward_matrix),
    family_k9 = stats::cutree(ward_hclust, k = 9),
    family_compare = stats::cutree(ward_hclust, k = k_compare),
    compared_solution = paste0("k=", k_compare)) %>%
    dplyr::count(compared_solution, family_k9, family_compare, name = "agreements") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(compared_solution, family_k9) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(share_of_k9_family = agreements / sum(agreements)) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()})

ward_solution_best_matches <- ward_solution_crosswalk %>%
  dplyr::group_by(compared_solution, family_k9) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(order_by = agreements, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    architecture_family_labels %>%
      dplyr::transmute(family_k9 = architecture_family_id, architecture_family_label),
    by = "family_k9") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(compared_solution, family_k9)

if (requireNamespace("mclust", quietly = TRUE)) {
  ward_solution_similarity <- tibble::tibble(
    comparison = c("k=8 vs k=9", "k=9 vs k=10"),
    adjusted_rand_index = c(
      mclust::adjustedRandIndex(stats::cutree(ward_hclust, k = 8), stats::cutree(ward_hclust, k = 9)),
      mclust::adjustedRandIndex(stats::cutree(ward_hclust, k = 9), stats::cutree(ward_hclust, k = 10))))
} else {
  ward_solution_similarity <- tibble::tibble(
    comparison = c("k=8 vs k=9", "k=9 vs k=10"),
    adjusted_rand_index = NA_real_)
}

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("WARD SOLUTION SENSITIVITY\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(ward_solution_sensitivity, n = Inf)
cat("\nBest matches between k=9 and adjacent solutions:\n")
print(ward_solution_best_matches, n = Inf)
cat("\nAdjusted Rand index, if mclust is installed:\n")
print(ward_solution_similarity, n = Inf)
```

## Agreement membership and substantive validation

The membership table is used to check whether the agreements grouped
into each family make legal and political sense. The table with index
scores adds the full institutional profile of each agreement and allows
closer inspection of whether family members actually share the defining
features suggested by the distinctive-index profiles.

```{r ward-family-membership, results="hide"}
# ---- WARD FAMILY MEMBERSHIP ------------------------------------------------

ward_family_membership <- architecture_families_final %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    architecture_family_id,
    Agreement) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    architecture_family_id,
    architecture_family,
    architecture_family_label,
    Agreement,
    RTA_ID,
    WB_ID,
    Date_EIF_G)

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("WARD FAMILY MEMBERSHIP\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(ward_family_membership, n = Inf)

# ---- FAMILY MEMBERSHIP WITH INDEX SCORES ----------------------------------

ward_family_membership_with_indices <- architecture_families_final %>%
  dplyr::mutate(RTA_ID = as.character(RTA_ID)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    ward_complete_data %>%
      dplyr::mutate(RTA_ID = as.character(RTA_ID)) %>%
      dplyr::select(RTA_ID, dplyr::all_of(ward_index_vars)),
    by = "RTA_ID")

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("FAMILY MEMBERSHIP WITH INDEX SCORES\n")
cat("==============================\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(ward_family_membership_with_indices), "\n")
cat("Index variables:", length(ward_index_vars), "\n")

stopifnot(
  nrow(ward_family_membership_with_indices) == nrow(architecture_families_final),
  sum(is.na(ward_family_membership_with_indices$architecture_family_label)) == 0)
```

## Merge family labels back to the full agreement dataset

The Ward clustering is estimated on complete cases only. This merge
keeps the full agreement-level index dataset and adds family labels
where a complete architecture profile was available.

```{r add-ward-families-to-agreement-level-index-data}
# ---- ADD WARD FAMILIES TO AGREEMENT-LEVEL INDEX DATA ----------------------
index_scores_with_families <- index_scores_final %>%
  dplyr::mutate(RTA_ID = as.character(RTA_ID)) %>%

        architecture_family_short),
    by = "RTA_ID")

index_scores_with_families_check <- tibble::tibble(
  full_agreements = nrow(index_scores_with_families),
  agreements_with_family = sum(!is.na(index_scores_with_families$architecture_family_id)),
  agreements_without_family = sum(is.na(index_scores_with_families$architecture_family_id)),

cat("==============================\n")
print(index_scores_with_families_check)

stopifnot(
  nrow(index_scores_with_families) == nrow(index_scores_final),
  index_scores_with_families_check$agreements_with_family == nrow(architecture_families_final))
```


```{r ward-family-heatmaps, fig.width=16, fig.height=8}

# ---- PLOT ONE HEATMAP PER WARD FAMILY -------

policy_breaks <- index_order_table %>%

family_ids <- sort(unique(ward_heatmap_data$architecture_family_id))

  agreement_levels <- rev(agreement_order_tbl$agreement_label)

  family_plot_data <- family_plot_data %>%
    dplyr::left_join(agreement_order_tbl, by = c("Agreement", "RTA_ID")) %>%

    ggplot2::geom_vline(
      xintercept = policy_breaks$xmax + 0.5, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3) +
    ggplot2::labs(
```
