```{r ward-family-heatmaps, fig.width=16, fig.height=8}
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 6.5),
      axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8),
      panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      legend.position = "right")

  print(p)
  
ggplot2::ggsave(

}
```

# Extended Ward Validation and Cluster-Solution Diagnostics

The following diagnostics lock the agreement-to-family mapping, correct the dendrogram colouring, and assess whether the retained `k = 9` solution is substantively preferable to the adjacent `k = 8` and `k = 10` solutions. Family numbers are arbitrary cluster identifiers; they are not ranks and do not have to appear from left to right in numerical order in the dendrogram.

## Heatmap × Ward membership audit

```{r final-family-membership-audit}
# ---- FINAL HEATMAP × CUTREE FAMILY MEMBERSHIP AUDIT ------------------------

cutree_family_truth <- tibble::tibble(
  RTA_ID = names(ward_clusters),
  cutree_family_id = as.integer(ward_clusters))

heatmap_family_truth <- ward_heatmap_data %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    RTA_ID,
    architecture_family_id,
    architecture_family_label) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(RTA_ID = as.character(RTA_ID)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    heatmap_family_id = architecture_family_id)

heatmap_cutree_audit <- cutree_family_truth %>%
  dplyr::mutate(RTA_ID = as.character(RTA_ID)) %>%
  dplyr::full_join(
    heatmap_family_truth,
    by = "RTA_ID") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    identical_assignment =
      cutree_family_id == heatmap_family_id)

family_set_audit <- purrr::map_dfr(
  1:9,
  function(fam) {

    cutree_ids <- sort(unique(
      cutree_family_truth$RTA_ID[
        cutree_family_truth$cutree_family_id == fam]))

    heatmap_ids <- sort(unique(
      heatmap_family_truth$RTA_ID[
        heatmap_family_truth$heatmap_family_id == fam]))

    tibble::tibble(
      architecture_family_id = fam,
      cutree_agreements = length(cutree_ids),
      heatmap_agreements = length(heatmap_ids),
      exact_same_agreement_set = identical(cutree_ids, heatmap_ids),
      only_in_cutree = paste(setdiff(cutree_ids, heatmap_ids), collapse = ", "),
      only_in_heatmap = paste(setdiff(heatmap_ids, cutree_ids), collapse = ", "))
  }) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    architecture_family_labels,
    by = "architecture_family_id") %>%
  dplyr::select(
    architecture_family_id,
    architecture_family_label,
    cutree_agreements,
    heatmap_agreements,
    exact_same_agreement_set,
    only_in_cutree,
    only_in_heatmap)

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("HEATMAP × CUTREE AGREEMENT-LEVEL AUDIT\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(
  heatmap_cutree_audit %>%
    dplyr::count(
      cutree_family_id,
      heatmap_family_id,
      identical_assignment),
  n = Inf)

cat("\nExact agreement sets by family:\n")
print(family_set_audit, n = Inf, width = Inf)

stopifnot(
  all(heatmap_cutree_audit$identical_assignment, na.rm = FALSE),
  all(family_set_audit$exact_same_agreement_set))
```

## Correctly coloured final dendrogram

```{r main-text-ward-dendrogram, fig.width=14, fig.height=7, dpi=300, fig.align="center", out.width="100%", fig.cap="Ward dendrogram of the 321 agreement profiles."}

# ---- WARD DENDROGRAM --------------------------------------------
stopifnot(
  ward_k_final == 9L,
  nrow(ward_matrix) == 321L,
  length(ward_clusters) == nrow(ward_matrix))

ward_dendrogram_main <- as.dendrogram(ward_hclust)
leaf_rta_ids <- labels(ward_dendrogram_main)
leaf_family_ids <- as.integer(ward_clusters[leaf_rta_ids])

stopifnot(
  length(leaf_family_ids) == nrow(ward_matrix),
  !anyNA(leaf_family_ids),
  all(leaf_family_ids %in% seq_len(ward_k_final)))

family_colours <- c(
  "1" = "#00AAAE",
  "2" = "#D95F02",
  "3" = "#FB6150",
  "4" = "#E7298A",
  "5" = "#4FB05E",
  "6" = "#EFBD6D",
  "7" = "#490062",
  "8" = "#1F78B4",
  "9" = "#911E6F")

# Determine the position and size of each family in the plotted tree.
visual_branch_order <- tibble::tibble(
  leaf_position = seq_along(leaf_rta_ids),
  architecture_family_id = leaf_family_ids) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(architecture_family_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    agreements = dplyr::n(),
    first_leaf = min(leaf_position),
    last_leaf = max(leaf_position),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(first_leaf) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    branch_midpoint = (first_leaf + last_leaf) / 2)

# Confirm that every family occupies one continuous branch.
stopifnot(
  nrow(visual_branch_order) == ward_k_final,
  all(visual_branch_order$agreements ==
        visual_branch_order$last_leaf -
        visual_branch_order$first_leaf + 1L))

# Colour the retained family branches in their visual order.
branch_colours_in_plot_order <- unname(
  family_colours[
    as.character(visual_branch_order$architecture_family_id)])

ward_dendrogram_main <- dendextend::color_branches(
  ward_dendrogram_main,
  k = ward_k_final,
  col = branch_colours_in_plot_order)

# Determine a valid cut height between the nine- and eight-cluster solutions.
n_agreements <- nrow(ward_matrix)
lower_merge <- n_agreements - ward_k_final
upper_merge <- lower_merge + 1L

ward_cut_height_k9 <- mean(
  ward_hclust$height[c(lower_merge, upper_merge)])

stopifnot(
  length(unique(stats::cutree(
    ward_hclust,
    h = ward_cut_height_k9))) == ward_k_final)

# Prepare the family labels used in the legend.
family_legend <- architecture_family_labels %>%
  dplyr::select(
    architecture_family_id,
    architecture_family_label) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(architecture_family_id)

stopifnot(
  nrow(family_legend) == ward_k_final,
  all(family_legend$architecture_family_id ==
        seq_len(ward_k_final)))

# Store the existing graphics settings before creating the two-panel figure.
old_par <- graphics::par(no.readonly = TRUE)
n_leaves <- length(leaf_rta_ids)

graphics::layout(
  matrix(c(1, 2), nrow = 2),
  heights = c(5, 1.4))

# full agreement-level dendrogram.
graphics::par(
  mar = c(1.0, 4.5, 1.0, 1.0),
  xpd = FALSE)

graphics::plot(
  ward_dendrogram_main,
  leaflab = "none",
  main = "",
  xlab = "",
  ylab = "Ward linkage height",
  ylim = c(-3, max(ward_hclust$height) * 1.05),
  cex.axis = 0.9,
  cex.lab = 0.95)

graphics::abline(
  h = ward_cut_height_k9,
  lty = 2,
  lwd = 2,
  col = "#AE123A")

plot_limits <- graphics::par("usr")

graphics::text(
  x = plot_limits[2] -
    0.01 * diff(plot_limits[1:2]),
  y = ward_cut_height_k9 + 0.6,
  labels = "k = 9 cut",
  adj = c(1, 0),
  cex = 0.8,
  col = "#AE123A")

graphics::text(
  x = visual_branch_order$branch_midpoint,
  y = -1.7,
  labels = paste0(
    "F",
    visual_branch_order$architecture_family_id,
    "\n(n = ",
    visual_branch_order$agreements,
    ")"),
  col = family_colours[
    as.character(
      visual_branch_order$architecture_family_id)],
  font = 2,
  cex = 0.9)

# Panel 2: full family-name legend.
graphics::par(
  mar = c(0, 1, 0.5, 1),
  xpd = FALSE)

graphics::plot.new()

graphics::legend(
  "center",
  legend = paste0(
    "F",
    family_legend$architecture_family_id,
    ": ",
    family_legend$architecture_family_label),
  col = family_colours[
    as.character(
      family_legend$architecture_family_id)],
  lwd = 4,
  cex = 0.72,
  bty = "n",
  ncol = 3,
  y.intersp = 1.3,
  x.intersp = 0.8)

# Save the completed figure as a high-resolution PNG.
figure_folder <- file.path(getwd(), "figures")
dir.create(
  figure_folder,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE)

ward_dendrogram_file <- file.path(
  figure_folder,
  "ward_dendrogram_k9.png")

grDevices::dev.copy(
  device = grDevices::png,
  filename = ward_dendrogram_file,
  width = 14,
  height = 7,
  units = "in",
  res = 300,
  bg = "white")

grDevices::dev.off()

message(
  "Figure saved as: ",
  normalizePath(
    ward_dendrogram_file,
    winslash = "/",
    mustWork = TRUE))


# Restore the standard single-panel layout and previous graphics settings.
graphics::layout(matrix(1))
graphics::par(old_par)

```

## Fusion heights and adjacent solutions

```{r extended-k-selection-diagnostics}
# ---- NUMERICAL DENDROGRAM AND ADJACENT-SOLUTION DIAGNOSTICS ---------------

n_agreements <- nrow(ward_matrix)

ward_fusion_heights <- tibble::tibble(
  merge_step = seq_along(ward_hclust$height),
  fusion_height = ward_hclust$height,
  clusters_after_merge = n_agreements - merge_step) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    height_jump = fusion_height - dplyr::lag(fusion_height),
    relative_height_jump =
      height_jump / dplyr::lag(fusion_height))

ward_final_fusions <- ward_fusion_heights %>%
  dplyr::filter(clusters_after_merge <= 15)

candidate_cut_gaps <- purrr::map_dfr(
  5:12,
  function(k_value) {

    lower_index <- n_agreements - k_value
    upper_index <- lower_index + 1L

    tibble::tibble(
      k = k_value,
      lower_fusion_height =
        ward_hclust$height[lower_index],
      upper_fusion_height =
        ward_hclust$height[upper_index],
      cut_height_gap =
        upper_fusion_height -
        lower_fusion_height)
  })

clusters_k8 <- stats::cutree(ward_hclust, k = 8)
clusters_k9 <- stats::cutree(ward_hclust, k = 9)
clusters_k10 <- stats::cutree(ward_hclust, k = 10)

adjacent_solution_membership <- tibble::tibble(
  RTA_ID = rownames(ward_matrix),
  family_k8 = as.integer(clusters_k8),
  family_k9 = as.integer(clusters_k9),
  family_k10 = as.integer(clusters_k10))

k8_merges_of_k9 <- adjacent_solution_membership %>%
  dplyr::distinct(family_k8, family_k9) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(family_k8) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_k9_families = dplyr::n_distinct(family_k9),
    k9_families = paste(sort(unique(family_k9)), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_k9_families > 1)

k10_splits_of_k9 <- adjacent_solution_membership %>%
  dplyr::distinct(family_k9, family_k10) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(family_k9) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_k10_families = dplyr::n_distinct(family_k10),
    k10_families = paste(sort(unique(family_k10)), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_k10_families > 1)

silhouette_by_solution <- function(cluster_vector, solution_name) {

  sil <- cluster::silhouette(
    cluster_vector,
    ward_distance)

  as.data.frame(sil) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("RTA_ID") %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      RTA_ID,
      cluster = as.integer(cluster),
      silhouette_width = sil_width) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(cluster) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      agreements = dplyr::n(),
      mean_silhouette = mean(silhouette_width),
      median_silhouette = stats::median(silhouette_width),
      negative_silhouette_share =
        mean(silhouette_width < 0),
      .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      solution = solution_name,
      .before = 1)
}

silhouette_adjacent_families <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  silhouette_by_solution(clusters_k8, "k=8"),
  silhouette_by_solution(clusters_k9, "k=9"),
  silhouette_by_solution(clusters_k10, "k=10"))

split_family_ids <- k10_splits_of_k9$family_k9

k10_split_agreements <- ward_complete_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    RTA_ID = as.character(RTA_ID),
    family_k9 = as.integer(clusters_k9[RTA_ID]),
    family_k10 = as.integer(clusters_k10[RTA_ID])) %>%
  dplyr::filter(family_k9 %in% split_family_ids) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    family_k9,
    family_k10,
    Agreement,
    RTA_ID,
    WB_ID,
    Date_EIF_G) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    family_k9,
    family_k10,
    Agreement)

k10_split_profiles_long <- ward_complete_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    RTA_ID = as.character(RTA_ID),
    family_k9 = as.integer(clusters_k9[RTA_ID]),
    family_k10 = as.integer(clusters_k10[RTA_ID])) %>%
  dplyr::filter(family_k9 %in% split_family_ids) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    family_k9,
    family_k10,
    dplyr::all_of(ward_index_vars)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::all_of(ward_index_vars),
    names_to = "index_name",
    values_to = "index_value") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    family_k9,
    family_k10,
    index_name) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_index = mean(index_value),
    .groups = "drop")

k10_split_top_differences <- k10_split_profiles_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    family_k9,
    index_name) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    lower_mean = min(mean_index),
    higher_mean = max(mean_index),
    absolute_mean_difference =
      higher_mean - lower_mean,
    lower_k10_family =
      family_k10[which.min(mean_index)],
    higher_k10_family =
      family_k10[which.max(mean_index)],
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(family_k9) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(
    order_by = absolute_mean_difference,
    n = 25,
    with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    index_groups %>%
      dplyr::select(
        index_name,
        policy_area,
        sub_area) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(),
    by = "index_name") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    family_k9,
    dplyr::desc(absolute_mean_difference))

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("FINAL WARD FUSION HEIGHTS\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(ward_final_fusions, n = Inf)
cat("\nCandidate cut-height gaps:\n")
print(candidate_cut_gaps, n = Inf)
cat("\nWhat k=8 merges from k=9:\n")
print(k8_merges_of_k9, n = Inf)
cat("\nWhat k=10 splits from k=9:\n")
print(k10_splits_of_k9, n = Inf)
cat("\nFamily-level silhouette diagnostics:\n")
print(silhouette_adjacent_families, n = Inf)
cat("\nAgreements in k=9 families split at k=10:\n")
print(k10_split_agreements, n = Inf)
cat("\nTop institutional differences created by k=10 split:\n")
print(k10_split_top_differences, n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

# Clustering-Sample Exclusion and Vintage Representativeness Audit

This section distinguishes exclusions that occurred before index construction from agreements that reached the 116-index dataset but were excluded from Ward clustering because their final index profile was incomplete. This is important for interpreting treaty-vintage patterns.

```{r full-agreement-exclusion-audit}
# ---- FULL AGREEMENT EXCLUSION AUDIT ----------------------------------------

initial_agreement_ids <- agreements_missingness %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    RTA_ID = as.character(RTA_ID),
    Agreement,
    Date_EIF_G,
    pct_missing)

ward_input_ids <- as.character(ward_input$RTA_ID)
ward_complete_ids <- as.character(ward_complete_data$RTA_ID)

analysis_scope_exclusion_audit <- initial_agreement_ids %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    exclusion_status = dplyr::case_when(
      pct_missing >= 99 ~
        "Fully uncoded in World Bank vertical data",
      abs(pct_missing - 18.58) <= 0.01 ~
        "Excluded treaty/accession coding pattern",
      Agreement ==
        "Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus)" ~
        "PACER Plus excluded: insufficient coded content",
      RTA_ID %in% as.character(raw_zero_ids) ~
        "Raw-zero agreement profile excluded",
      RTA_ID %in% ward_complete_ids ~
        "Included in Ward clustering",
      RTA_ID %in% ward_input_ids ~
        "Excluded from Ward: incomplete final index profile",
      TRUE ~
        "Removed before Ward input / other")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    entry_year = lubridate::year(Date_EIF_G),
    treaty_vintage = dplyr::case_when(
      entry_year <= 2004 ~ "Before 2005",
      entry_year <= 2014 ~ "2005–2014",
      entry_year >= 2015 ~ "2015–2023",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_))

analysis_scope_exclusion_summary <- analysis_scope_exclusion_audit %>%
  dplyr::count(
    exclusion_status,
    name = "agreements") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(agreements))

fully_uncoded_agreements_audit <- analysis_scope_exclusion_audit %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    exclusion_status ==
      "Fully uncoded in World Bank vertical data") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    uk_named_agreement = stringr::str_detect(
      Agreement,
      stringr::regex(
        "United Kingdom|\\bUK\\b",
        ignore_case = TRUE))) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Agreement)

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("FULL AGREEMENT EXCLUSION AUDIT\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(analysis_scope_exclusion_summary, n = Inf)
cat("\nFully uncoded agreements:\n")
print(
  fully_uncoded_agreements_audit %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Agreement,
      RTA_ID,
      Date_EIF_G,
      pct_missing,
      uk_named_agreement),
  n = Inf)

cat(
  "\nFully uncoded agreements identified as UK-related by name:",
  sum(fully_uncoded_agreements_audit$uk_named_agreement, na.rm = TRUE),
  "\n")
```

```{r vintage-representativeness-check}
# ---- VINTAGE REPRESENTATIVENESS OF THE CLUSTERING SAMPLE -------------------

vintage_missingness_check <- ward_input %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    RTA_ID = as.character(RTA_ID),
    included_in_clustering =
      RTA_ID %in% ward_complete_ids,
    entry_year = lubridate::year(Date_EIF_G),
    treaty_vintage = dplyr::case_when(
      entry_year <= 2004 ~ "Before 2005",
      entry_year <= 2014 ~ "2005–2014",
      entry_year >= 2015 ~ "2015–2023",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(treaty_vintage)) %>%
  dplyr::count(
    treaty_vintage,
    included_in_clustering,
    name = "agreements") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(treaty_vintage) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    vintage_total = sum(agreements),
    share = agreements / vintage_total) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

vintage_missingness_table <- xtabs(
  agreements ~ treaty_vintage + included_in_clustering,
  data = vintage_missingness_check)

vintage_missingness_chi <- suppressWarnings(
  stats::chisq.test(
    vintage_missingness_table,
    correct = FALSE))

if (any(vintage_missingness_chi$expected < 5)) {
  vintage_missingness_test <- stats::fisher.test(vintage_missingness_table)
} else {
  vintage_missingness_test <- vintage_missingness_chi
}

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("VINTAGE REPRESENTATIVENESS CHECK\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(vintage_missingness_check, n = Inf)
print(vintage_missingness_table)
print(vintage_missingness_test)
```

# Negotiating-Hub Affiliation and Institutional Similarity

This is a post-clustering validation analysis. Major negotiating parties are identified from agreement names after the architecture families have already been estimated. Hub affiliation is therefore not used to construct the clusters. Because some plurilateral agreements are associated with several major parties, hub categories are non-exclusive.

```{r negotiating-hub-affiliations, results="hide"}
# ---- CONSTRUCT NEGOTIATING-HUB AFFILIATIONS -------------------------------

hub_template_data <- ward_family_membership_with_indices %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Agreement = as.character(Agreement),
    entry_year = lubridate::year(Date_EIF_G),

    hub_eu = stringr::str_detect(
      Agreement,
      stringr::regex(
        "(^EU\\b|^EC[- ]|European Union|European Communities)",
        ignore_case = TRUE)),

    hub_efta = stringr::str_detect(
      Agreement,
      stringr::regex(
        "\\bEFTA\\b|European Free Trade Association",
        ignore_case = TRUE)),

    hub_us = stringr::str_detect(
      Agreement,
      stringr::regex(
        "United States|\\bUS\\b|NAFTA|USMCA|CAFTA",
        ignore_case = TRUE)),

    hub_canada = stringr::str_detect(
      Agreement,
      stringr::regex(
        "\\bCanada\\b|NAFTA|USMCA",
        ignore_case = TRUE)),

    hub_chile = stringr::str_detect(
      Agreement,
      stringr::regex(
        "\\bChile\\b|Pacific Alliance",
        ignore_case = TRUE)),

    hub_japan = stringr::str_detect(
      Agreement,
      stringr::regex(
        "\\bJapan\\b|RCEP",
        ignore_case = TRUE)),

    hub_korea = stringr::str_detect(
      Agreement,
      stringr::regex(
        "Korea|Republic of Korea|RCEP",
        ignore_case = TRUE)),

    hub_singapore = stringr::str_detect(
      Agreement,
      stringr::regex(
        "\\bSingapore\\b|RCEP",
        ignore_case = TRUE)),

    hub_china = stringr::str_detect(
      Agreement,
      stringr::regex(
        "\\bChina\\b|RCEP",
        ignore_case = TRUE)),

    hub_asean = stringr::str_detect(
      Agreement,
      stringr::regex(
        "\\bASEAN\\b|AFTA|RCEP",
        ignore_case = TRUE)),

    hub_uk = stringr::str_detect(
      Agreement,
      stringr::regex(
        "United Kingdom|\\bUK\\b",
        ignore_case = TRUE)),

    treaty_vintage = dplyr::case_when(
      entry_year <= 2004 ~ "Before 2005",
      entry_year <= 2014 ~ "2005–2014",
      entry_year >= 2015 ~ "2015–2023",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_))

hub_vars <- c(
  "hub_eu",
  "hub_efta",
  "hub_us",
  "hub_canada",
  "hub_chile",
  "hub_japan",
  "hub_korea",
  "hub_singapore",
  "hub_china",
  "hub_asean",
  "hub_uk")

hub_agreement_membership_audit <- hub_template_data %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Agreement,
    RTA_ID,
    architecture_family_id,
    architecture_family_label,
    entry_year,
    dplyr::all_of(hub_vars)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::all_of(hub_vars),
    names_to = "hub",
    values_to = "hub_present") %>%
  dplyr::filter(hub_present) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    hub = stringr::str_to_upper(
      stringr::str_remove(hub, "^hub_"))) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    hub,
    entry_year,
    Agreement)

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("NEGOTIATING-HUB MEMBERSHIP AUDIT\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(hub_agreement_membership_audit, n = Inf)
```

```{r same-hub-institutional-similarity}
# ---- SAME-HUB SIMILARITY IN THE 116-DIMENSIONAL ARCHITECTURE SPACE --------

hub_similarity_data <- hub_template_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    dplyr::if_any(
      dplyr::all_of(hub_vars),
      ~ .x)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(RTA_ID)

hub_architecture_matrix <- hub_similarity_data %>%
  dplyr::select(
    dplyr::all_of(ward_index_vars)) %>%
  as.matrix()

hub_membership_matrix <- hub_similarity_data %>%
  dplyr::select(
    dplyr::all_of(hub_vars)) %>%
  as.matrix()

storage.mode(hub_membership_matrix) <- "logical"

hub_architecture_distance <- as.matrix(
  stats::dist(
    hub_architecture_matrix,
    method = "euclidean"))

agreement_pairs <- utils::combn(
  seq_len(nrow(hub_similarity_data)),
  2)

pair_i <- agreement_pairs[1, ]
pair_j <- agreement_pairs[2, ]

pairwise_hub_similarity <- tibble::tibble(
  agreement_i = hub_similarity_data$Agreement[pair_i],
  agreement_j = hub_similarity_data$Agreement[pair_j],
  architecture_distance =
    hub_architecture_distance[
      cbind(pair_i, pair_j)],
  same_hub =
    rowSums(
      hub_membership_matrix[
        pair_i, ,
        drop = FALSE] &
      hub_membership_matrix[
        pair_j, ,
        drop = FALSE]) > 0,
  year_difference =
    abs(
      hub_similarity_data$entry_year[pair_i] -
      hub_similarity_data$entry_year[pair_j]))

same_hub_similarity_summary <- pairwise_hub_similarity %>%
  dplyr::group_by(same_hub) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    agreement_pairs = dplyr::n(),
    mean_architecture_distance =
      mean(architecture_distance),
    median_architecture_distance =
      stats::median(architecture_distance),
    mean_year_difference =
      mean(year_difference),
    .groups = "drop")

set.seed(2026)

observed_hub_difference <- mean(
  pairwise_hub_similarity$architecture_distance[
    pairwise_hub_similarity$same_hub]) -
  mean(
    pairwise_hub_similarity$architecture_distance[
      !pairwise_hub_similarity$same_hub])

n_permutations <- 2000

permuted_hub_differences <- replicate(
  n_permutations,
  {

    permuted_hubs <- hub_membership_matrix[
      sample(seq_len(nrow(hub_membership_matrix))), ,
      drop = FALSE]

    permuted_same_hub <- rowSums(
      permuted_hubs[
        pair_i, ,
        drop = FALSE] &
      permuted_hubs[
        pair_j, ,
        drop = FALSE]) > 0

    mean(
      pairwise_hub_similarity$architecture_distance[
        permuted_same_hub]) -
      mean(
        pairwise_hub_similarity$architecture_distance[
          !permuted_same_hub])
  })

hub_similarity_permutation_test <- tibble::tibble(
  observed_mean_distance_difference =
    observed_hub_difference,
  permutation_p_value =
    (sum(
      permuted_hub_differences <=
        observed_hub_difference) + 1) /
    (n_permutations + 1))

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("NEGOTIATING-HUB SIMILARITY TEST\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(same_hub_similarity_summary, n = Inf)
print(hub_similarity_permutation_test, n = Inf)
```

```{r vintage-stratified-hub-similarity}
# ---- NEGOTIATING-HUB SIMILARITY WITHIN TREATY VINTAGE ---------------------

set.seed(2026)

hub_vintage_data <- hub_template_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(treaty_vintage),
    dplyr::if_any(
      dplyr::all_of(hub_vars),
      ~ .x)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(RTA_ID)

hub_vintage_architecture_matrix <- hub_vintage_data %>%
  dplyr::select(
    dplyr::all_of(ward_index_vars)) %>%
  as.matrix()

hub_vintage_distance_matrix <- as.matrix(
  stats::dist(
    hub_vintage_architecture_matrix,
    method = "euclidean"))

hub_vintage_membership_matrix <- hub_vintage_data %>%
  dplyr::select(
    dplyr::all_of(hub_vars)) %>%
  as.matrix()

storage.mode(hub_vintage_membership_matrix) <- "logical"

hub_vintage_pairs <- utils::combn(
  seq_len(nrow(hub_vintage_data)),
  2)

pair_i_v <- hub_vintage_pairs[1, ]
pair_j_v <- hub_vintage_pairs[2, ]

same_vintage_pair <- hub_vintage_data$treaty_vintage[pair_i_v] ==
  hub_vintage_data$treaty_vintage[pair_j_v]

pair_i_vintage <- pair_i_v[same_vintage_pair]
pair_j_vintage <- pair_j_v[same_vintage_pair]

observed_same_hub_vintage <- rowSums(
  hub_vintage_membership_matrix[
    pair_i_vintage, ,
    drop = FALSE] &
  hub_vintage_membership_matrix[
    pair_j_vintage, ,
    drop = FALSE]) > 0

observed_distance_vintage <- hub_vintage_distance_matrix[
  cbind(
    pair_i_vintage,
    pair_j_vintage)]

hub_similarity_within_vintage_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  same_hub = observed_same_hub_vintage,
  architecture_distance = observed_distance_vintage) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(same_hub) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    agreement_pairs = dplyr::n(),
    mean_architecture_distance =
      mean(architecture_distance),
    median_architecture_distance =
      stats::median(architecture_distance),
    .groups = "drop")

observed_vintage_stratified_difference <- mean(
  observed_distance_vintage[
      observed_same_hub_vintage]) -
  mean(
    observed_distance_vintage[
      !observed_same_hub_vintage])

vintage_groups <- split(
  seq_len(nrow(hub_vintage_data)),
  hub_vintage_data$treaty_vintage)

n_permutations_vintage <- 2000

permuted_vintage_differences <- replicate(
  n_permutations_vintage,
  {

    permutation_index <- seq_len(nrow(hub_vintage_data))

    for (vintage_group in vintage_groups) {
      permutation_index[vintage_group] <- sample(
        vintage_group,
          length(vintage_group),
          replace = FALSE)
    }

    permuted_hubs <- hub_vintage_membership_matrix[
      permutation_index, ,
      drop = FALSE]

    permuted_same_hub <- rowSums(
      permuted_hubs[
        pair_i_vintage, ,
        drop = FALSE] &
      permuted_hubs[
        pair_j_vintage, ,
        drop = FALSE]) > 0

    if (
      all(permuted_same_hub) ||
      all(!permuted_same_hub)
    ) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }

    mean(
      observed_distance_vintage[
        permuted_same_hub]) -
      mean(
        observed_distance_vintage[
          !permuted_same_hub])
  })

permuted_vintage_differences <- permuted_vintage_differences[
  !is.na(permuted_vintage_differences)]

vintage_stratified_permutation_p <- (
  sum(
      permuted_vintage_differences <=
        observed_vintage_stratified_difference
    ) + 1
  ) / (length(permuted_vintage_differences) + 1)

hub_similarity_vintage_stratified_test <- tibble::tibble(
  same_vintage_pairs = length(observed_distance_vintage),
  observed_mean_distance_difference = observed_vintage_stratified_difference,
  mean_permuted_difference = mean(permuted_vintage_differences),
  permutation_p_value = vintage_stratified_permutation_p,
  permutations = length(permuted_vintage_differences))

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("VINTAGE-STRATIFIED NEGOTIATING-HUB SIMILARITY TEST\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(
  hub_similarity_within_vintage_summary,
  n = Inf)

print(
  hub_similarity_vintage_stratified_test,
  n = Inf)
```

```{r negotiating-hub-similarity-figure, fig.width=9, fig.height=5.4, fig.align="center", out.width="100%", fig.cap="Institutional architecture distance by negotiating-hub affiliation."}
# ---- FIGURE 3: NEGOTIATING-HUB INSTITUTIONAL SIMILARITY -------------------

hub_similarity_plot_all <- pairwise_hub_similarity %>%

hub_similarity_plot_vintage <- tibble::tibble(

print(figure_hub_similarity_distribution)
```

# Bilateral Trade Panel and PPML Models for Ward Architecture Families

This section builds the final directed exporter-importer-year panel
for the Ward architecture-family analysis. The estimation sample is
restricted to dyad-years covered by agreements with valid Ward family
assignments. It does not create a general DTA-versus-no-DTA comparison
group.

```{r check-required-objects}
# ---- CHECK REQUIRED OBJECTS ------------------------------------------------
# This section must be run after the final Ward architecture-family section.

if (!requireNamespace("fixest", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("The package 'fixest' is required. Install it with install.packages('fixest').")
}

required_ward_objects <- c("index_scores_with_families", "architecture_families_final")
missing_ward_objects <- required_ward_objects[!vapply(required_ward_objects, exists, logical(1))]

if (length(missing_ward_objects) > 0) {
  stop(paste("Missing required Ward objects:", paste(missing_ward_objects, collapse = ", ")))
}

# ---- PREPARE VALID AGREEMENT-FAMILY LOOKUP ---------------------------------
# One row per Ward-coded agreement. This links each agreement's WB_ID to its
# final Ward architecture family.

valid_family_agreements <- index_scores_with_families %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(architecture_family_id)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(RTA_ID = as.character(RTA_ID), WB_ID = as.character(WB_ID)) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    WB_ID, RTA_ID, Agreement, Date_EIF_G,
    architecture_family_id, architecture_family, architecture_family_label,
    architecture_family_short) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

valid_family_agreements_check <- tibble::tibble(
  agreements = nrow(valid_family_agreements),
  unique_wb_ids = dplyr::n_distinct(valid_family_agreements$WB_ID),
  unique_rta_ids = dplyr::n_distinct(valid_family_agreements$RTA_ID),
  families = dplyr::n_distinct(valid_family_agreements$architecture_family_id),
  missing_wb_ids = sum(is.na(valid_family_agreements$WB_ID)),
  duplicate_wb_ids = sum(duplicated(valid_family_agreements$WB_ID)))

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("VALID AGREEMENT-FAMILY LOOKUP CHECK\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(valid_family_agreements_check)

stopifnot(
  valid_family_agreements_check$agreements == nrow(architecture_families_final),
  valid_family_agreements_check$families == 9,
  valid_family_agreements_check$missing_wb_ids == 0,
  valid_family_agreements_check$duplicate_wb_ids == 0)

# ---- PREPARE DTA BILATERAL INFORMATION ------------------------------------
# Directed dyad-year agreement coverage from the DTA Bilateral Information sheet.
# The sheet is treated as directed: iso1 -> iso2.

dta_file <- here::here("DTA 2.0 - Vertical Content (v2).xlsx")

if (!file.exists(dta_file)) {
  stop("DTA file not found. Check the file name and location: DTA 2.0 - Vertical Content (v2).xlsx")
}

dta_bilateral_info <- readxl::read_excel(dta_file, sheet = "Bilateral Information") %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    exporter_iso3 = stringr::str_to_upper(iso1),
    importer_iso3 = stringr::str_to_upper(iso2),
    WB_ID = as.character(wbid),
    dta_agreement_name = rta_name,
    year = as.integer(year),
    economy1 = economy1,
    economy2 = economy2) %>%
  dplyr::filter(year >= 1995, year <= 2023, !is.na(WB_ID)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

dta_bilateral_info_check <- tibble::tibble(
  rows = nrow(dta_bilateral_info),
  agreements = dplyr::n_distinct(dta_bilateral_info$WB_ID),
  directed_dyads = dplyr::n_distinct(paste(dta_bilateral_info$exporter_iso3, dta_bilateral_info$importer_iso3, sep = "_")),
  years_min = min(dta_bilateral_info$year),
  years_max = max(dta_bilateral_info$year),
  missing_exporter = sum(is.na(dta_bilateral_info$exporter_iso3)),
  missing_importer = sum(is.na(dta_bilateral_info$importer_iso3)),
  missing_wb_id = sum(is.na(dta_bilateral_info$WB_ID)))

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("DTA BILATERAL INFORMATION CHECK\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(dta_bilateral_info_check)

stopifnot(
  dta_bilateral_info_check$missing_exporter == 0,
  dta_bilateral_info_check$missing_importer == 0,
  dta_bilateral_info_check$missing_wb_id == 0)

# ---- MERGE WARD FAMILIES TO DTA BILATERAL COVERAGE -------------------------
# Adds Ward architecture-family labels to directed dyad-year agreement rows.

active_dta_families_directed <- dta_bilateral_info %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(valid_family_agreements, by = "WB_ID") %>%
  dplyr::select(
    exporter_iso3, importer_iso3, year, WB_ID, RTA_ID, Agreement, Date_EIF_G,
    architecture_family_id, architecture_family, architecture_family_label,
    architecture_family_short) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

valid_family_agreements_without_bilateral_rows <- valid_family_agreements %>%
  dplyr::anti_join(dta_bilateral_info %>% dplyr::distinct(WB_ID), by = "WB_ID") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Date_EIF_G, Agreement)

active_dta_families_directed_check <- tibble::tibble(
  valid_family_agreements = nrow(valid_family_agreements),
  agreements_with_bilateral_rows = dplyr::n_distinct(active_dta_families_directed$WB_ID),
  agreements_without_bilateral_rows = nrow(valid_family_agreements_without_bilateral_rows),
  rows = nrow(active_dta_families_directed),
  directed_dyads = dplyr::n_distinct(paste(active_dta_families_directed$exporter_iso3, active_dta_families_directed$importer_iso3, sep = "_")),
  years_min = min(active_dta_families_directed$year),
  years_max = max(active_dta_families_directed$year),
  families = dplyr::n_distinct(active_dta_families_directed$architecture_family_id),
  duplicate_rows = sum(duplicated(active_dta_families_directed)))

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("ACTIVE DTA FAMILY COVERAGE CHECK\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(active_dta_families_directed_check)

if (nrow(valid_family_agreements_without_bilateral_rows) > 0) {
  cat("\nFirst Ward-coded agreements without bilateral rows:\n")
  print(valid_family_agreements_without_bilateral_rows, n = 30)
}

stopifnot(
  active_dta_families_directed_check$rows > 0,
  active_dta_families_directed_check$families == dplyr::n_distinct(valid_family_agreements$architecture_family_id),
  active_dta_families_directed_check$duplicate_rows == 0)

# ---- COLLAPSE WARD FAMILY EXPOSURE TO DYAD-YEAR ----------------------------
# Creates one row per directed exporter-importer-year with active Ward-coded DTA
# exposure. Multiple active agreements are retained through family indicators.

family_var_lookup <- valid_family_agreements %>%
  dplyr::distinct(architecture_family_id, architecture_family_label, architecture_family_short) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(architecture_family_id) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(family_exposure_var = paste0("active_", architecture_family_short))

family_exposure_vars <- family_var_lookup %>%
  dplyr::pull(family_exposure_var)

active_family_flags <- active_dta_families_directed %>%
  dplyr::mutate(family_exposure_var = paste0("active_", architecture_family_short), active = 1L) %>%
  dplyr::select(exporter_iso3, importer_iso3, year, family_exposure_var, active) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = family_exposure_var, values_from = active, values_fill = 0L)

missing_family_vars <- setdiff(family_exposure_vars, names(active_family_flags))

for (v in missing_family_vars) {
  active_family_flags[[v]] <- 0L
}

active_family_flags <- active_family_flags %>%
  dplyr::select(exporter_iso3, importer_iso3, year, dplyr::all_of(family_exposure_vars))

active_dta_families_collapsed <- active_dta_families_directed %>%
  dplyr::group_by(exporter_iso3, importer_iso3, year) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    active_agreements = dplyr::n_distinct(WB_ID),
    active_families = dplyr::n_distinct(architecture_family_id),
    WB_IDs = paste(sort(unique(WB_ID)), collapse = " | "),
    agreement_names = paste(sort(unique(Agreement)), collapse = " | "),
    architecture_family_labels = paste(sort(unique(architecture_family_label)), collapse = " | "),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(active_family_flags, by = c("exporter_iso3", "importer_iso3", "year")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(family_exposure_vars), ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, 0L)))

active_dta_families_collapsed_check <- tibble::tibble(
  dyad_years = nrow(active_dta_families_collapsed),
  directed_dyads = dplyr::n_distinct(paste(active_dta_families_collapsed$exporter_iso3, active_dta_families_collapsed$importer_iso3, sep = "_")),
  years_min = min(active_dta_families_collapsed$year),
  years_max = max(active_dta_families_collapsed$year),
  max_active_agreements = max(active_dta_families_collapsed$active_agreements),
  max_active_families = max(active_dta_families_collapsed$active_families),
  dyad_years_with_multiple_agreements = sum(active_dta_families_collapsed$active_agreements > 1),
  dyad_years_with_multiple_families = sum(active_dta_families_collapsed$active_families > 1),
  duplicate_dyad_years = sum(duplicated(active_dta_families_collapsed[c("exporter_iso3", "importer_iso3", "year")])),
  missing_family_values = sum(is.na(active_dta_families_collapsed[family_exposure_vars])))

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("COLLAPSED WARD FAMILY EXPOSURE CHECK\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(active_dta_families_collapsed_check)

stopifnot(
  active_dta_families_collapsed_check$duplicate_dyad_years == 0,
  active_dta_families_collapsed_check$missing_family_values == 0)

# ---- PREPARE BACI TRADE PANEL ---------------------------------------------
# BACI is product-level trade data. This chunk aggregates it to directed
# exporter-importer-year exports. BACI values are in thousand USD.

baci_dir <- here::here("BACI_HS92_V202601")
baci_country_file <- file.path(baci_dir, "country_codes_V202601.csv")

if (!dir.exists(baci_dir)) {
  stop("BACI folder not found. Expected folder in project root: BACI_HS92_V202601")
}

if (!file.exists(baci_country_file)) {
  stop("BACI country-code file not found. Expected file: BACI_HS92_V202601/country_codes_V202601.csv")
}

baci_country_codes_raw <- readr::read_csv(baci_country_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  janitor::clean_names()

if (!"country_code" %in% names(baci_country_codes_raw)) {
  stop("BACI country-code file does not contain a country_code column.")
}

baci_iso_col <- dplyr::case_when(
  "iso_3digit_alpha" %in% names(baci_country_codes_raw) ~ "iso_3digit_alpha",
  "country_iso3" %in% names(baci_country_codes_raw) ~ "country_iso3",
  "iso3" %in% names(baci_country_codes_raw) ~ "iso3",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_)

if (is.na(baci_iso_col)) {
  stop("BACI country-code file does not contain an ISO3 column.")
}

baci_country_codes <- baci_country_codes_raw %>%
  dplyr::transmute(country_code = as.integer(country_code), iso3 = stringr::str_to_upper(.data[[baci_iso_col]])) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(country_code), !is.na(iso3)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

baci_files <- list.files(
  path = baci_dir,
  pattern = "^BACI_HS92_Y(199[5-9]|20[0-1][0-9]|202[0-3])_V202601\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE)

if (length(baci_files) == 0) {
  stop("No BACI yearly files found. Expected files like BACI_HS92_Y1995_V202601.csv.")
}

process_baci_file <- function(file) {
  readr::read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    janitor::clean_names() %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      year = as.integer(t),
      exporter_code = as.integer(i),
      importer_code = as.integer(j),
      exports_thousand_usd = as.numeric(v)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(year >= 1995, year <= 2023) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(year, exporter_code, importer_code) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(exports_thousand_usd = sum(exports_thousand_usd, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
}

baci_trade_panel <- purrr::map_dfr(baci_files, process_baci_file) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    baci_country_codes %>% dplyr::rename(exporter_code = country_code, exporter_iso3 = iso3),
    by = "exporter_code") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    baci_country_codes %>% dplyr::rename(importer_code = country_code, importer_iso3 = iso3),
    by = "importer_code") %>%
  dplyr::select(exporter_iso3, importer_iso3, year, exports_thousand_usd) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(exporter_iso3), !is.na(importer_iso3), exporter_iso3 != importer_iso3) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(exporter_iso3, importer_iso3, year) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(exports_thousand_usd = sum(exports_thousand_usd, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

baci_trade_panel_check <- tibble::tibble(
  rows = nrow(baci_trade_panel),
  directed_dyads = dplyr::n_distinct(paste(baci_trade_panel$exporter_iso3, baci_trade_panel$importer_iso3, sep = "_")),
  years_min = min(baci_trade_panel$year),
  years_max = max(baci_trade_panel$year),
  zero_trade_rows = sum(baci_trade_panel$exports_thousand_usd == 0),
  positive_trade_rows = sum(baci_trade_panel$exports_thousand_usd > 0),
  missing_trade_values = sum(is.na(baci_trade_panel$exports_thousand_usd)),
  duplicate_dyad_years = sum(duplicated(baci_trade_panel[c("exporter_iso3", "importer_iso3", "year")])) )

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("BACI TRADE PANEL CHECK\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(baci_trade_panel_check)

stopifnot(
  baci_trade_panel_check$years_min >= 1995,
  baci_trade_panel_check$years_max <= 2023,
  baci_trade_panel_check$missing_trade_values == 0,
  baci_trade_panel_check$duplicate_dyad_years == 0)

# ---- CREATE WARD FAMILY TRADE PANEL ----------------------------------------
# Missing BACI trade rows are coded as zero only after excluding dyad-years in
# which at least one partner is outside BACI's country-code universe.

dta_country_codes <- active_dta_families_collapsed %>%
  dplyr::select(exporter_iso3, importer_iso3) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = dplyr::everything(), names_to = "role", values_to = "iso3") %>%
  dplyr::distinct(iso3) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(iso3)

baci_country_codes_available <- baci_country_codes %>%
  dplyr::distinct(iso3) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(iso3)

dta_codes_missing_in_baci <- dta_country_codes %>%
  dplyr::anti_join(baci_country_codes_available, by = "iso3") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(iso3)

baci_missing_country_codes <- dta_codes_missing_in_baci %>%
  dplyr::pull(iso3)

active_dta_families_collapsed_baci_covered <- active_dta_families_collapsed %>%
  dplyr::filter(!(exporter_iso3 %in% baci_missing_country_codes | importer_iso3 %in% baci_missing_country_codes))

ward_family_trade_panel_raw <- active_dta_families_collapsed_baci_covered %>%
  dplyr::left_join(baci_trade_panel, by = c("exporter_iso3", "importer_iso3", "year"))

ward_family_trade_panel <- ward_family_trade_panel_raw %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    exports_thousand_usd = tidyr::replace_na(exports_thousand_usd, 0),
    dyad_id = paste(exporter_iso3, importer_iso3, sep = "_"),
    exporter_year = paste(exporter_iso3, year, sep = "_"),
    importer_year = paste(importer_iso3, year, sep = "_"))

baci_coverage_check <- tibble::tibble(
  rows_before_baci_coverage_filter = nrow(active_dta_families_collapsed),
  rows_after_baci_coverage_filter = nrow(active_dta_families_collapsed_baci_covered),
  rows_removed_not_baci_covered = rows_before_baci_coverage_filter - rows_after_baci_coverage_filter,
  share_removed_not_baci_covered = round(rows_removed_not_baci_covered / rows_before_baci_coverage_filter, 3),
  countries_not_baci_covered = paste(baci_missing_country_codes, collapse = ", "))

ward_family_trade_panel_match_check <- tibble::tibble(
  rows = nrow(ward_family_trade_panel_raw),
  missing_baci_matches_after_coverage_filter = sum(is.na(ward_family_trade_panel_raw$exports_thousand_usd)),
  matched_baci_flows = sum(!is.na(ward_family_trade_panel_raw$exports_thousand_usd)))

ward_family_trade_panel_check <- tibble::tibble(
  rows = nrow(ward_family_trade_panel),
  directed_dyads = dplyr::n_distinct(ward_family_trade_panel$dyad_id),
  years_min = min(ward_family_trade_panel$year),
  years_max = max(ward_family_trade_panel$year),
  active_agreement_dyad_years = sum(ward_family_trade_panel$active_agreements > 0),
  zero_trade_rows = sum(ward_family_trade_panel$exports_thousand_usd == 0),
  positive_trade_rows = sum(ward_family_trade_panel$exports_thousand_usd > 0),
  missing_trade_values = sum(is.na(ward_family_trade_panel$exports_thousand_usd)),
  duplicate_dyad_years = sum(duplicated(ward_family_trade_panel[c("exporter_iso3", "importer_iso3", "year")])),
  missing_family_values = sum(is.na(ward_family_trade_panel[family_exposure_vars])))

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("BACI COUNTRY-COVERAGE CHECK\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(baci_coverage_check)
cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("WARD FAMILY TRADE PANEL MATCH CHECK\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(ward_family_trade_panel_match_check)
cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("WARD FAMILY TRADE PANEL CHECK\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(ward_family_trade_panel_check)

stopifnot(
  ward_family_trade_panel_check$rows == nrow(active_dta_families_collapsed_baci_covered),
  ward_family_trade_panel_check$missing_trade_values == 0,
  ward_family_trade_panel_check$duplicate_dyad_years == 0,
  ward_family_trade_panel_check$missing_family_values == 0)

# ---- INSPECT WARD FAMILY TRADE PANEL ---------------------------------------
# Descriptive overview before PPML estimation.

ward_family_trade_summary <- ward_family_trade_panel %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = dplyr::all_of(family_exposure_vars), names_to = "family_exposure_var", values_to = "active") %>%

  dplyr::arrange(architecture_family_id)

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("WARD FAMILY TRADE SUMMARY\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(ward_family_trade_summary, n = Inf)

# ---- PREPARE PPML FAMILY PANELS -------------------------------------------
# Main panel: keeps only dyad-years with one active architecture family.
# Robustness panel: keeps all dyad-years and models overlapping family exposure.

baseline_family_short <- "minimalist_institutional"
baseline_family_var <- paste0("active_", baseline_family_short)

missing_family_vars <- setdiff(family_exposure_vars, names(ward_family_trade_panel))

if (length(missing_family_vars) > 0) {
  stop(paste("Missing family indicators in ward_family_trade_panel:", paste(missing_family_vars, collapse = ", ")))
}

ward_family_trade_panel_single <- ward_family_trade_panel %>%
  dplyr::filter(active_families == 1) %>%

  dplyr::select(-row_id, -active_family)

ward_family_trade_panel_overlap <- ward_family_trade_panel

ppml_panel_check <- tibble::tibble(
  full_panel_rows = nrow(ward_family_trade_panel),
  single_family_rows = nrow(ward_family_trade_panel_single),
  overlapping_family_rows = sum(ward_family_trade_panel$active_families > 1),
  single_family_share = round(nrow(ward_family_trade_panel_single) / nrow(ward_family_trade_panel), 3),
  families_single_panel = dplyr::n_distinct(ward_family_trade_panel_single$architecture_family_short),
  missing_trade_single = sum(is.na(ward_family_trade_panel_single$exports_thousand_usd)),

  duplicate_single_dyad_years = sum(duplicated(ward_family_trade_panel_single[c("exporter_iso3", "importer_iso3", "year")])) )

single_family_distribution <- ward_family_trade_panel_single %>%
  dplyr::count(architecture_family_id, architecture_family_short, name = "dyad_years") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(share = round(dyad_years / sum(dyad_years), 3)) %>%

overlap_distribution <- ward_family_trade_panel_overlap %>%

cat("\n==============================\n")

stopifnot(
  ppml_panel_check$families_single_panel == 9,

  ppml_panel_check$missing_trade_overlap == 0,
  ppml_panel_check$duplicate_single_dyad_years == 0)

# ---- LOAD CEPII GEODIST CONTROLS ------------------------------------------
# CEPII GeoDist provides time-invariant bilateral gravity controls.

cepii_file <- here::here("dist_cepii 2.xls")

if (!file.exists(cepii_file)) {
  stop("CEPII file not found. Check that 'dist_cepii 2.xls' is saved in the project folder.")
}

cepii_raw <- readxl::read_excel(cepii_file, sheet = "dist_cepii") %>%
  janitor::clean_names()

required_cepii_vars <- c("iso_o", "iso_d", "dist", "contig", "comlang_off", "colony", "comcol", "smctry")

}

  dplyr::transmute(
    exporter_iso3 = stringr::str_to_upper(iso_o),
    importer_iso3 = stringr::str_to_upper(iso_d),
    cepii_dist = as.numeric(dist),
    cepii_log_dist = log(cepii_dist),
    cepii_contig = as.integer(contig),
    cepii_comlang_off = as.integer(comlang_off),
    cepii_colony = as.integer(colony),
    cepii_comcol = as.integer(comcol),
    cepii_smctry = as.integer(smctry)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(exporter_iso3), !is.na(importer_iso3), !is.na(cepii_log_dist)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

cepii_controls_check <- tibble::tibble(
  rows = nrow(cepii_controls),
  directed_dyads = dplyr::n_distinct(paste(cepii_controls$exporter_iso3, cepii_controls$importer_iso3, sep = "_")),
  missing_log_dist = sum(is.na(cepii_controls$cepii_log_dist)),
  duplicate_dyads = sum(duplicated(cepii_controls[c("exporter_iso3", "importer_iso3")])) )

cat("\n==============================\n")

cat("==============================\n")
print(cepii_controls_check)

stopifnot(
  cepii_controls_check$missing_log_dist == 0,
  cepii_controls_check$duplicate_dyads == 0)

# ---- MERGE CEPII CONTROLS TO PPML PANELS ----------------------------------
# Only clear historical ISO-code differences are recoded for CEPII matching.
# Original country codes are preserved in the analysis panel.

recode_cepii_iso <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    x == "ROU" ~ "ROM",
    x == "COD" ~ "ZAR",
    TRUE ~ x)
}

cepii_control_vars <- c(
  "cepii_log_dist",
  "cepii_contig",
  "cepii_comlang_off",
  "cepii_colony",
  "cepii_comcol",
  "cepii_smctry")

cepii_controls_for_merge <- cepii_controls %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    cepii_exporter_iso3 = exporter_iso3,
    cepii_importer_iso3 = importer_iso3)

ward_family_trade_panel_single_controls_raw <- ward_family_trade_panel_single %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cepii_exporter_iso3 = recode_cepii_iso(exporter_iso3),
    cepii_importer_iso3 = recode_cepii_iso(importer_iso3)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(cepii_controls_for_merge, by = c("cepii_exporter_iso3", "cepii_importer_iso3"))

ward_family_trade_panel_overlap_controls_raw <- ward_family_trade_panel_overlap %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cepii_exporter_iso3 = recode_cepii_iso(exporter_iso3),
    cepii_importer_iso3 = recode_cepii_iso(importer_iso3)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(cepii_controls_for_merge, by = c("cepii_exporter_iso3", "cepii_importer_iso3"))

ward_family_trade_panel_single_controls <- ward_family_trade_panel_single_controls_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::if_all(dplyr::all_of(cepii_control_vars), ~ !is.na(.x)))

ward_family_trade_panel_overlap_controls <- ward_family_trade_panel_overlap_controls_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::if_all(dplyr::all_of(cepii_control_vars), ~ !is.na(.x)))

cepii_merge_check <- tibble::tibble(
  single_rows_before = nrow(ward_family_trade_panel_single),
  single_rows_after = nrow(ward_family_trade_panel_single_controls),
  single_rows_lost = single_rows_before - single_rows_after,
  single_rows_lost_share = round(single_rows_lost / single_rows_before, 3),
  overlap_rows_before = nrow(ward_family_trade_panel_overlap),
  overlap_rows_after = nrow(ward_family_trade_panel_overlap_controls),
  overlap_rows_lost = overlap_rows_before - overlap_rows_after,
  overlap_rows_lost_share = round(overlap_rows_lost / overlap_rows_before, 3))

cepii_loss_by_family <- ward_family_trade_panel_single_controls_raw %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cepii_matched = !is.na(cepii_log_dist)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(architecture_family_short, architecture_family_label) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    rows = dplyr::n(),
    lost_rows = sum(!cepii_matched),
    lost_share = round(lost_rows / rows, 3),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(lost_share))

cepii_control_summary <- ward_family_trade_panel_single_controls %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_log_dist = mean(cepii_log_dist, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_log_dist = stats::median(cepii_log_dist, na.rm = TRUE),
    contiguity_share = mean(cepii_contig == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    common_language_share = mean(cepii_comlang_off == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    colony_share = mean(cepii_colony == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    common_colonizer_share = mean(cepii_comcol == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    same_country_history_share = mean(cepii_smctry == 1, na.rm = TRUE))

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("CEPII MERGE CHECK\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(cepii_merge_check)
cat("\nCEPII losses by family:\n")
print(cepii_loss_by_family, n = Inf)
cat("\nCEPII control summary:\n")
print(cepii_control_summary)
```

# Final PPML Models and Thesis Outputs

This section estimates the final PPML gravity models and creates the
result objects used in the thesis. It defines the final PPML
and heterogeneity snippets. The preferred model is the single-family
CEPII-controlled specification. The no-CEPII and overlap models are
robustness checks.

```{r final-ppml-input-check}
# ---- FINAL PPML INPUT CHECK ------------------------------------------------

required_final_objects <- c(
  "ward_family_trade_panel_single",
  "ward_family_trade_panel_single_controls",
  "ward_family_trade_panel_overlap_controls",
  "family_var_lookup",
  "family_exposure_vars")

missing_final_objects <- required_final_objects[!vapply(required_final_objects, exists, logical(1))]

if (length(missing_final_objects) > 0) {
  stop(paste("Missing required object(s):", paste(missing_final_objects, collapse = ", ")))
}

baseline_family_short <- "minimalist_institutional"
baseline_family_var <- paste0("active_", baseline_family_short)
nonbaseline_family_vars <- setdiff(family_exposure_vars, baseline_family_var)

family_label_lookup <- family_var_lookup %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    architecture_family_short = as.character(architecture_family_short),
    architecture_family_label = architecture_family_label,
    architecture_family_label_short = dplyr::case_when(
      architecture_family_short == "minimalist_institutional" ~ "Minimalist",
      architecture_family_short == "trade_facilitation_regulatory_governance" ~ "Trade facilitation / regulatory governance",
      architecture_family_short == "services_competition_mobility_governance" ~ "Services / competition / mobility",
      architecture_family_short == "services_investment_capital_mobility" ~ "Services-investment / capital mobility",
      architecture_family_short == "comprehensive_market_access_enforcement" ~ "Market access / enforcement",
      architecture_family_short == "public_procurement_governance" ~ "Public procurement",
      architecture_family_short == "preferential_goods_trade_administration" ~ "Goods-trade administration",
      architecture_family_short == "export_liberalisation_regulatory_compatibility" ~ "Export liberalisation / compatibility",
      architecture_family_short == "sustainable_development_regulatory_integration" ~ "Sustainable-development and regulatory integration",
      TRUE ~ architecture_family_label)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

ward_family_trade_panel_single <- ward_family_trade_panel_single %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    architecture_family_factor = factor(architecture_family_short),
    architecture_family_factor = stats::relevel(architecture_family_factor, ref = baseline_family_short))

ward_family_trade_panel_single_controls <- ward_family_trade_panel_single_controls %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    architecture_family_factor = factor(architecture_family_short),
    architecture_family_factor = stats::relevel(architecture_family_factor, ref = baseline_family_short))

stopifnot(
  baseline_family_short %in% ward_family_trade_panel_single_controls$architecture_family_short,
  all(nonbaseline_family_vars %in% names(ward_family_trade_panel_overlap_controls)))

# ---- ESTIMATE FINAL PPML MODELS -------------------------------------------

ppml_main_cepii <- fixest::fepois(
  exports_thousand_usd ~ architecture_family_factor + cepii_log_dist + cepii_contig +
    cepii_comlang_off + cepii_colony + cepii_comcol + cepii_smctry |
    exporter_year + importer_year,
  data = ward_family_trade_panel_single_controls,
  vcov = ~ dyad_id)

ppml_single_no_cepii <- fixest::fepois(
  exports_thousand_usd ~ architecture_family_factor | exporter_year + importer_year,
  data = ward_family_trade_panel_single,
  vcov = ~ dyad_id)

ppml_overlap_cepii_formula <- stats::as.formula(
  paste(
    "exports_thousand_usd ~",
    paste(nonbaseline_family_vars, collapse = " + "),
    "+ cepii_log_dist + cepii_contig + cepii_comlang_off + cepii_colony + cepii_comcol + cepii_smctry",
    "| exporter_year + importer_year"))

ppml_overlap_cepii <- fixest::fepois(
  ppml_overlap_cepii_formula,
  data = ward_family_trade_panel_overlap_controls,
  vcov = ~ dyad_id)

ppml_model_check <- tibble::tibble(
  model = c(
    "Main: single-family + CEPII",
    "Robustness: single-family, no CEPII",
    "Robustness: overlap + CEPII"),
  estimation_data_rows = c(
    nrow(ward_family_trade_panel_single_controls),
    nrow(ward_family_trade_panel_single),
    nrow(ward_family_trade_panel_overlap_controls)),
  observations_used = c(
    stats::nobs(ppml_main_cepii),
    stats::nobs(ppml_single_no_cepii),
    stats::nobs(ppml_overlap_cepii)))

print(ppml_model_check, n = Inf)

# ---- HELPER FUNCTIONS FOR MODEL OUTPUTS -----------------------------------

coeftable_to_tibble <- function(model) {
  out <- as.data.frame(fixest::coeftable(model)) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("term")

  se_col <- names(out)[stringr::str_detect(names(out), "Std")][1]
  stat_col <- names(out)[stringr::str_detect(names(out), "z value|t value")][1]
  p_col <- names(out)[stringr::str_detect(names(out), "Pr\\(")][1]

  out %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      term = term,
      estimate = .data[["Estimate"]],
      std_error = .data[[se_col]],
      statistic = .data[[stat_col]],
      p_value = .data[[p_col]])
}

find_family_term <- function(model, family_short, factor_variable = "architecture_family_factor") {
  model_terms <- names(stats::coef(model))
  candidate_terms <- c(
    paste0(factor_variable, family_short),
    paste0(factor_variable, "::", family_short))
  matched_term <- candidate_terms[candidate_terms %in% model_terms]
  if (length(matched_term) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  matched_term[1]
}

make_family_ranking <- function(model, model_data, family_lookup, group_key = NA_character_, group_label = NA_character_) {
  model_coef <- stats::coef(model)
  model_vcov <- stats::vcov(model)
  family_levels <- levels(droplevels(model_data$architecture_family_factor))
  family_levels <- c(baseline_family_short, setdiff(family_levels, baseline_family_short))

  get_family_estimate <- function(family_short, coefficient_term) {
    if (family_short == baseline_family_short) return(0)
    if (is.na(coefficient_term)) return(NA_real_)
    as.numeric(model_coef[coefficient_term])
  }

  get_family_std_error <- function(family_short, coefficient_term) {
    if (family_short == baseline_family_short) return(0)
    if (is.na(coefficient_term)) return(NA_real_)
    variance <- as.numeric(model_vcov[coefficient_term, coefficient_term])
    if (!is.finite(variance) | variance < 0) return(NA_real_)
    sqrt(variance)
  }

  out <- tibble::tibble(
    group_key = group_key,
    group_label = group_label,
    architecture_family_short = family_levels,
    coefficient_term = vapply(family_levels, function(x) find_family_term(model, x), character(1))) %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      estimate = get_family_estimate(architecture_family_short, coefficient_term),
      std_error = get_family_std_error(architecture_family_short, coefficient_term)) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(percent_difference_vs_baseline = 100 * (exp(estimate) - 1)) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(family_lookup, by = "architecture_family_short") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      model_data %>% dplyr::count(architecture_family_short, name = "family_rows"),
      by = "architecture_family_short") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(family_rows = dplyr::coalesce(family_rows, 0L)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(estimate)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(estimate)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(rank = dplyr::row_number())

  out
}

make_pairwise_contrasts <- function(model, family_ranking, group_key = NA_character_, group_label = NA_character_) {
  if (nrow(family_ranking) < 2) return(tibble::tibble())

  model_coef <- stats::coef(model)
  model_vcov <- stats::vcov(model)

  get_beta <- function(family_short) {
    if (family_short == baseline_family_short) return(0)
    term <- find_family_term(model, family_short)
    if (is.na(term)) return(NA_real_)
    as.numeric(model_coef[term])
  }

  get_var <- function(family_short) {
    if (family_short == baseline_family_short) return(0)
    term <- find_family_term(model, family_short)
    if (is.na(term)) return(NA_real_)
    as.numeric(model_vcov[term, term])
  }

  get_cov <- function(family_a, family_b) {
    if (family_a == baseline_family_short | family_b == baseline_family_short) return(0)
    term_a <- find_family_term(model, family_a)
    term_b <- find_family_term(model, family_b)
    if (is.na(term_a) | is.na(term_b)) return(NA_real_)
    as.numeric(model_vcov[term_a, term_b])
  }

  ranked_families <- family_ranking %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(estimate)) %>%
    dplyr::pull(architecture_family_short)

  family_rows <- family_ranking %>%
    dplyr::select(architecture_family_short, family_rows, architecture_family_label_short)

  out <- utils::combn(ranked_families, 2, simplify = FALSE) %>%
    purrr::map_dfr(function(pair) {
      family_a <- pair[1]
      family_b <- pair[2]
      estimate_difference <- get_beta(family_a) - get_beta(family_b)
      variance_difference <- get_var(family_a) + get_var(family_b) - 2 * get_cov(family_a, family_b)
      std_error <- ifelse(is.finite(variance_difference) & variance_difference >= 0, sqrt(variance_difference), NA_real_)
      z_value <- estimate_difference / std_error
      p_value <- 2 * stats::pnorm(abs(z_value), lower.tail = FALSE)
      conf_low <- estimate_difference - 1.96 * std_error
      conf_high <- estimate_difference + 1.96 * std_error

      tibble::tibble(
        group_key = group_key,
        group_label = group_label,
        family_a = family_a,
        family_b = family_b,
        estimate_difference = estimate_difference,
        std_error = std_error,
        z_value = z_value,
        p_value = p_value,
        conf_low = conf_low,
        conf_high = conf_high,
        percent_difference = 100 * (exp(estimate_difference) - 1),
        conf_low_percent = 100 * (exp(conf_low) - 1),
        conf_high_percent = 100 * (exp(conf_high) - 1))})

  if (nrow(out) == 0) return(out)

  out %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      family_rows %>% dplyr::rename(family_a = architecture_family_short, family_a_rows = family_rows, family_a_label = architecture_family_label_short),
      by = "family_a") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      family_rows %>% dplyr::rename(family_b = architecture_family_short, family_b_rows = family_rows, family_b_label = architecture_family_label_short),
      by = "family_b") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(group_key, group_label) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(p_value_holm = stats::p.adjust(p_value, method = "holm")) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      significant_unadjusted = p_value < 0.05,
      significant_holm = p_value_holm < 0.05,
      comparison = paste0(family_a_label, " vs ", family_b_label),
      estimate_summary = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", estimate_difference, std_error),
      percent_summary = sprintf("%.1f%% [%.1f, %.1f]", percent_difference, conf_low_percent, conf_high_percent)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(group_key, dplyr::desc(estimate_difference))
}

extract_factor_effects <- function(model, term_prefix, family_lookup) {
  coeftable_to_tibble(model) %>%
    dplyr::filter(stringr::str_detect(term, paste0("^", term_prefix))) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      architecture_family_short = stringr::str_remove(term, paste0("^", term_prefix, "(::)?")),
      conf_low = estimate - 1.96 * std_error,
      conf_high = estimate + 1.96 * std_error,
      percent_difference = 100 * (exp(estimate) - 1),
      conf_low_percent = 100 * (exp(conf_low) - 1),
      conf_high_percent = 100 * (exp(conf_high) - 1)) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(family_lookup, by = "architecture_family_short") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(percent_difference))
}

# ---- FINAL PPML EFFECT TABLES ---------------------------------------------

ppml_main_cepii_effects <- extract_factor_effects(
```

## Agreement-level support and robustness diagnostics

The following diagnostics evaluate whether family-level estimates are
supported by broad agreement coverage or are concentrated in a small
number of large agreements, regional blocs, or country pairs. These
checks qualify the strength of the main PPML estimates.

```{r architecture-family-support-diagnostics}
# ---- ARCHITECTURE-FAMILY SUPPORT DIAGNOSTICS -------------------------------

required_support_objects <- c(
  "ward_family_trade_panel_single_controls",
  "active_dta_families_directed",
  "valid_family_agreements",
  "family_label_lookup")

missing_support_objects <- required_support_objects[!vapply(required_support_objects, exists, logical(1))]

if (length(missing_support_objects) > 0) {
  stop(paste("Missing required object(s):", paste(missing_support_objects, collapse = ", ")))
}

diagnostic_main_panel <- ward_family_trade_panel_single_controls %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    exporter_iso3 = stringr::str_to_upper(exporter_iso3),
    importer_iso3 = stringr::str_to_upper(importer_iso3),
    year = as.integer(year),
    architecture_family_short = as.character(architecture_family_short),
    dyad_id = paste(exporter_iso3, importer_iso3, sep = "_")) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    exporter_iso3,
    importer_iso3,
    year,
    dyad_id,
    architecture_family_short,
    exports_thousand_usd,
    dplyr::any_of(c("active_agreements", "active_families"))) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

family_panel_support <- diagnostic_main_panel %>%
  dplyr::group_by(architecture_family_short) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    model_dyad_years = dplyr::n(),
    directed_dyads = dplyr::n_distinct(dyad_id),
    exporters = dplyr::n_distinct(exporter_iso3),
    importers = dplyr::n_distinct(importer_iso3),
    zero_trade_rows = sum(exports_thousand_usd == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    zero_trade_share = zero_trade_rows / model_dyad_years,
    .groups = "drop")

agreement_exposure_main <- active_dta_families_directed %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    exporter_iso3 = stringr::str_to_upper(exporter_iso3),
    importer_iso3 = stringr::str_to_upper(importer_iso3),
    year = as.integer(year),
    WB_ID = as.character(WB_ID),
    RTA_ID = as.character(RTA_ID),
    architecture_family_short = as.character(architecture_family_short)) %>%
  dplyr::semi_join(
    diagnostic_main_panel %>%
      dplyr::select(exporter_iso3, importer_iso3, year, architecture_family_short),
    by = c("exporter_iso3", "importer_iso3", "year", "architecture_family_short")) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    exporter_iso3,
    importer_iso3,
    year,
    WB_ID,
    RTA_ID,
    Agreement,
    architecture_family_short,
    architecture_family_label)

agreement_support_by_family <- valid_family_agreements %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    WB_ID = as.character(WB_ID),
    RTA_ID = as.character(RTA_ID),
    architecture_family_short = as.character(architecture_family_short)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(architecture_family_short, architecture_family_label) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(classified_agreements = dplyr::n_distinct(WB_ID), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    agreement_exposure_main %>%
      dplyr::group_by(architecture_family_short) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(agreements_observed_in_main_panel = dplyr::n_distinct(WB_ID), .groups = "drop"),
    by = "architecture_family_short") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(agreements_observed_in_main_panel = dplyr::coalesce(agreements_observed_in_main_panel, 0L))

agreement_concentration_by_family <- agreement_exposure_main %>%
  dplyr::mutate(agreement_dyad_year = paste(exporter_iso3, importer_iso3, year, sep = "_")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(architecture_family_short, architecture_family_label, WB_ID, RTA_ID, Agreement) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    agreement_dyad_years = dplyr::n_distinct(agreement_dyad_year),
    agreement_directed_dyads = dplyr::n_distinct(paste(exporter_iso3, importer_iso3, sep = "_")),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    family_panel_support %>%
      dplyr::select(architecture_family_short, family_model_dyad_years = model_dyad_years),
    by = "architecture_family_short") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(agreement_share_of_family_rows = agreement_dyad_years / family_model_dyad_years) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(architecture_family_short) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(agreement_share_of_family_rows), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(agreement_rank_within_family = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

largest_agreement_by_family <- agreement_concentration_by_family %>%
  dplyr::filter(agreement_rank_within_family == 1) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    architecture_family_short,
    largest_agreement_wb_id = WB_ID,
    largest_agreement_name = Agreement,
    largest_agreement_dyad_years = agreement_dyad_years,
    largest_agreement_share_of_family_rows = agreement_share_of_family_rows)

top_agreements_by_family <- agreement_concentration_by_family %>%
  dplyr::filter(agreement_rank_within_family <= 5) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    architecture_family_label,
    architecture_family_short,
    agreement_rank_within_family,
    WB_ID,
    RTA_ID,
    Agreement,
    agreement_dyad_years,
    agreement_directed_dyads,
    agreement_share_of_family_rows)

top_exporter_by_family <- diagnostic_main_panel %>%
  dplyr::group_by(architecture_family_short, exporter_iso3) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(exporter_rows = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(architecture_family_short) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(exporter_share = exporter_rows / sum(exporter_rows)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(exporter_share), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::rename(top_exporter_iso3 = exporter_iso3)

top_importer_by_family <- diagnostic_main_panel %>%
  dplyr::group_by(architecture_family_short, importer_iso3) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(importer_rows = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(architecture_family_short) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(importer_share = importer_rows / sum(importer_rows)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(importer_share), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::rename(top_importer_iso3 = importer_iso3)

family_support_diagnostic <- family_panel_support %>%
  dplyr::left_join(agreement_support_by_family, by = "architecture_family_short") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(largest_agreement_by_family, by = "architecture_family_short") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(top_exporter_by_family, by = "architecture_family_short") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(top_importer_by_family, by = "architecture_family_short") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(family_label_lookup, by = "architecture_family_short") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    zero_trade_share = round(zero_trade_share, 3),
    largest_agreement_share_of_family_rows = round(largest_agreement_share_of_family_rows, 3),
    exporter_share = round(exporter_share, 3),
    importer_share = round(importer_share, 3),
    small_agreement_family = classified_agreements < 20,
    moderate_agreement_concentration = largest_agreement_share_of_family_rows >= 0.25,
    high_agreement_concentration = largest_agreement_share_of_family_rows >= 0.50,
    high_exporter_concentration = exporter_share >= 0.25,
    high_importer_concentration = importer_share >= 0.25) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    architecture_family_label_short,
    architecture_family_short,
    classified_agreements,
    agreements_observed_in_main_panel,
    model_dyad_years,
    directed_dyads,
    exporters,
    importers,
    zero_trade_share,
    largest_agreement_name,
    largest_agreement_dyad_years,
    largest_agreement_share_of_family_rows,
    top_exporter_iso3,
    exporter_share,
    top_importer_iso3,
    importer_share,
    small_agreement_family,
    moderate_agreement_concentration,
    high_agreement_concentration,
    high_exporter_concentration,
    high_importer_concentration) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(largest_agreement_share_of_family_rows))

family_support_red_flags <- family_support_diagnostic %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    small_agreement_family |
      moderate_agreement_concentration |
      high_agreement_concentration |
      high_exporter_concentration |
      high_importer_concentration)

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("ARCHITECTURE-FAMILY SUPPORT DIAGNOSTIC\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(family_support_diagnostic, n = Inf, width = Inf)
cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("TOP FIVE AGREEMENTS WITHIN EACH ARCHITECTURE FAMILY\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(top_agreements_by_family, n = Inf, width = Inf)
cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("FAMILY SUPPORT RED FLAGS\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(family_support_red_flags, n = Inf, width = Inf)

# ---- STRICT SINGLE-AGREEMENT ROBUSTNESS ------------------------------------

if (!"active_agreements" %in% names(ward_family_trade_panel_single_controls)) {
  ppml_main_cepii_strict_single_agreement <- NULL
  ppml_main_cepii_strict_single_agreement_tw <- NULL
  ppml_strict_single_agreement_check <- tibble::tibble(
    model = "Strict single-agreement CEPII",
    estimation_data_rows = NA_integer_,
    observations_used = NA_integer_)
  cat("Column active_agreements is not available. Strict single-agreement robustness was not estimated.\n")
} else {
  ward_family_trade_panel_strict_single_agreement <- ward_family_trade_panel_single_controls %>%
    dplyr::filter(active_agreements == 1) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      architecture_family_factor = stats::relevel(architecture_family_factor, ref = baseline_family_short))

  ward_family_trade_panel_strict_single_agreement <- ward_family_trade_panel_strict_single_agreement %>%
    dplyr::mutate(strict_agreement_id = stringr::str_squish(as.character(WB_IDs)))

  ppml_main_cepii_strict_single_agreement <- fixest::fepois(
    exports_thousand_usd ~ architecture_family_factor + cepii_log_dist + cepii_contig +
      cepii_comlang_off + cepii_colony + cepii_comcol + cepii_smctry |
      exporter_year + importer_year,
    data = ward_family_trade_panel_strict_single_agreement,
    vcov = ~ dyad_id)

  ppml_main_cepii_strict_single_agreement_tw <- fixest::fepois(
    exports_thousand_usd ~ architecture_family_factor + cepii_log_dist + cepii_contig +
      cepii_comlang_off + cepii_colony + cepii_comcol + cepii_smctry |
      exporter_year + importer_year,
    data = ward_family_trade_panel_strict_single_agreement,
    vcov = ~ dyad_id + strict_agreement_id)

  ppml_strict_single_agreement_check <- tibble::tibble(
    model = c("Main CEPII", "Strict single-agreement CEPII", "Strict single-agreement CEPII, dyad + agreement clustered"),
    estimation_data_rows = c(
      nrow(ward_family_trade_panel_single_controls),
      nrow(ward_family_trade_panel_strict_single_agreement),
      nrow(ward_family_trade_panel_strict_single_agreement)),
    observations_used = c(
      stats::nobs(ppml_main_cepii),
      stats::nobs(ppml_main_cepii_strict_single_agreement),
      stats::nobs(ppml_main_cepii_strict_single_agreement_tw)))

  ppml_strict_single_agreement_effects <- extract_factor_effects(
    ppml_main_cepii_strict_single_agreement,
    "architecture_family_factor",
    family_label_lookup)

  cat("\n==============================\n")
  cat("STRICT SINGLE-AGREEMENT MODEL CHECK\n")
  cat("==============================\n")
  print(ppml_strict_single_agreement_check, n = Inf, width = Inf)

  fixest::etable(
    ppml_main_cepii,
    ppml_main_cepii_strict_single_agreement,
    ppml_main_cepii_strict_single_agreement_tw,
    vcov = list(~ dyad_id, ~ dyad_id, ~ dyad_id + strict_agreement_id),
    tex = FALSE,
    fitstat = ~ n + ll + pr2 + bic)
}
```
