## Dominant-agreement leave-one-out robustness

The bilateral unit of analysis is retained. This check does not aggregate regional agreements into a single observation. Instead, it asks whether an architecture-family coefficient is driven primarily by dyad-years generated by one very large agreement. The test is applied to families in which the largest agreement accounts for at least 30% of family dyad-years in the main single-family panel.

```{r dominant-agreement-leave-one-out}
# ---- DOMINANT-AGREEMENT LEAVE-ONE-OUT ROBUSTNESS --------------------------

dominant_agreement_loo_candidates <- agreement_concentration_by_family %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    agreement_rank_within_family == 1,
    agreement_share_of_family_rows >= 0.30) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    architecture_family_short,
    architecture_family_label,
    WB_ID,
    RTA_ID,
    Agreement,
    agreement_dyad_years,
    agreement_share_of_family_rows) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(
      agreement_share_of_family_rows))

main_effect_reference <- ppml_main_cepii_effects %>%
  dplyr::select(
    architecture_family_short,
    main_estimate = estimate,
    main_std_error = std_error,
    main_p_value = p_value,
    main_percent_difference = percent_difference)

dominant_agreement_loo_models <- list()
dominant_agreement_loo_effects_list <- list()
dominant_agreement_loo_model_checks <- list()

for (row_id in seq_len(nrow(dominant_agreement_loo_candidates))) {

  candidate <- dominant_agreement_loo_candidates[row_id, ]

  candidate_keys <- agreement_exposure_main %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      WB_ID == candidate$WB_ID) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(
      exporter_iso3,
      importer_iso3,
      year)

  loo_data <- ward_family_trade_panel_single_controls %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      exporter_iso3 =
        stringr::str_to_upper(exporter_iso3),
      importer_iso3 =
        stringr::str_to_upper(importer_iso3),
      year = as.integer(year)) %>%
    dplyr::anti_join(
      candidate_keys,
      by = c(
        "exporter_iso3",
        "importer_iso3",
        "year")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      architecture_family_factor =
        factor(architecture_family_short),
      architecture_family_factor =
        stats::relevel(
          architecture_family_factor,
          ref = baseline_family_short))

  loo_model <- tryCatch(
    fixest::fepois(
      exports_thousand_usd ~
        architecture_family_factor +
        cepii_log_dist +
        cepii_contig +
        cepii_comlang_off +
        cepii_colony +
        cepii_comcol +
        cepii_smctry |
        exporter_year + importer_year,
      data = loo_data,
      vcov = ~ dyad_id),
    error = function(e) e)

  model_name <- paste0(
    candidate$architecture_family_short,
    "__without__",
    candidate$WB_ID)

  dominant_agreement_loo_models[[model_name]] <- loo_model

  if (inherits(loo_model, "fixest")) {

    loo_effects <- extract_factor_effects(
      loo_model,
      "architecture_family_factor",
      family_label_lookup) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        excluded_family =
          candidate$architecture_family_short,
        excluded_agreement =
          candidate$Agreement,
        excluded_WB_ID =
          candidate$WB_ID,
        excluded_share_of_family_rows =
          candidate$agreement_share_of_family_rows,
        .before = 1) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(
        main_effect_reference,
        by = "architecture_family_short") %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        estimate_change =
          estimate - main_estimate,
        absolute_estimate_change =
          abs(estimate_change),
        percent_difference_change =
          percent_difference -
          main_percent_difference)

    dominant_agreement_loo_effects_list[[model_name]] <- loo_effects

    dominant_agreement_loo_model_checks[[model_name]] <- tibble::tibble(
      excluded_family =
          candidate$architecture_family_short,
        excluded_agreement =
          candidate$Agreement,
        excluded_WB_ID =
          candidate$WB_ID,
        rows_after_exclusion =
          nrow(loo_data),
        observations_used =
          stats::nobs(loo_model),
        estimated = TRUE,
        error_message = NA_character_)

  } else {

    dominant_agreement_loo_model_checks[[model_name]] <- tibble::tibble(
      excluded_family =
          candidate$architecture_family_short,
        excluded_agreement =
          candidate$Agreement,
        excluded_WB_ID =
          candidate$WB_ID,
        rows_after_exclusion =
          nrow(loo_data),
        observations_used =
          NA_integer_,
        estimated = FALSE,
        error_message =
          conditionMessage(loo_model))
  }
}

dominant_agreement_loo_effects_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  dominant_agreement_loo_effects_list)

dominant_agreement_loo_model_check <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  dominant_agreement_loo_model_checks)

dominant_agreement_loo_target_effects <- dominant_agreement_loo_effects_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    excluded_family != baseline_family_short,
    architecture_family_short ==
      excluded_family) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    excluded_family,
    excluded_agreement,
    excluded_WB_ID,
    excluded_share_of_family_rows,
    architecture_family_label_short,
    main_estimate,
    estimate,
    estimate_change,
    main_p_value,
    p_value,
    main_percent_difference,
    percent_difference,
    percent_difference_change)

dominant_agreement_loo_change_summary <- dominant_agreement_loo_effects_all %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    excluded_family,
    excluded_agreement,
    excluded_WB_ID,
    excluded_share_of_family_rows) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    coefficients_compared =
      dplyr::n(),
    max_absolute_estimate_change =
      max(
        absolute_estimate_change,
        na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_absolute_estimate_change =
      mean(
        absolute_estimate_change,
        na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(
      excluded_share_of_family_rows))

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("DOMINANT-AGREEMENT LEAVE-ONE-OUT ROBUSTNESS\n")
cat("==============================\n")
cat("\nCandidates:\n")
print(
  tibble::as_tibble(dominant_agreement_loo_candidates),
  n = Inf,
  width = Inf)

cat("\nModel checks:\n")
print(
  tibble::as_tibble(dominant_agreement_loo_model_check),
  n = Inf,
  width = Inf)

cat("\nOwn-family coefficient after excluding the dominant agreement:\n")
print(
  tibble::as_tibble(dominant_agreement_loo_target_effects),
  n = Inf,
  width = Inf)

cat("\nOverall coefficient sensitivity by exclusion:\n")
print(
  tibble::as_tibble(dominant_agreement_loo_change_summary),
  n = Inf,
  width = Inf)
```

```{r dyad-fe-feasibility}
# ---- DYAD-FE FEASIBILITY AND ROBUSTNESS -----------------------------------
# This is a feasibility/limitation check. Because few dyads switch architecture
# families over time, dyad-FE estimates should not be treated as the main
# robustness specification unless within-dyad switching is substantial.

dyad_family_variation <- ward_family_trade_panel_single_controls %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dyad_id, year) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(dyad_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    years_observed = dplyr::n_distinct(year),
    families_observed = dplyr::n_distinct(architecture_family_short),
    first_year = min(year, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_year = max(year, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_family = architecture_family_short[which.min(year)],
    last_family = architecture_family_short[which.max(year)],
    switched_family = families_observed > 1,
    .groups = "drop")

dyad_fe_feasibility_check <- dyad_family_variation %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    directed_dyads = dplyr::n(),
    switching_dyads = sum(switched_family, na.rm = TRUE),
    switching_dyad_share = round(switching_dyads / directed_dyads, 3),
    dyads_with_multiple_years = sum(years_observed > 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    dyads_with_multiple_families = sum(families_observed > 1, na.rm = TRUE))

dyad_family_transitions <- ward_family_trade_panel_single_controls %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dyad_id, year) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(dyad_id) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(previous_family = dplyr::lag(architecture_family_short)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(previous_family), previous_family != architecture_family_short) %>%
  dplyr::count(previous_family, architecture_family_short, name = "transition_count") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(transition_count))

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("DYAD-FE FEASIBILITY CHECK\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(dyad_fe_feasibility_check, n = Inf, width = Inf)
cat("\nObserved architecture-family transitions within dyads:\n")
print(dyad_family_transitions, n = Inf, width = Inf)

if (dyad_fe_feasibility_check$switching_dyads < 50 || nrow(dyad_family_transitions) == 0) {
  ppml_dyad_fe <- NULL
  dyad_fe_model_check <- tibble::tibble(
    model = "Dyad-FE robustness",
    estimation_data_rows = nrow(ward_family_trade_panel_single_controls),
    observations_used = NA_integer_,
    estimated = FALSE,
    note = "Insufficient within-dyad architecture-family switching")
} else {
  ppml_dyad_fe <- tryCatch(
    fixest::fepois(
      exports_thousand_usd ~ architecture_family_factor |
        exporter_year + importer_year + dyad_id,
      data = ward_family_trade_panel_single_controls,
      vcov = ~ dyad_id),
    error = function(e) e)

  dyad_fe_model_check <- tibble::tibble(
    model = "Dyad-FE robustness",
    estimation_data_rows = nrow(ward_family_trade_panel_single_controls),
    observations_used = if (inherits(ppml_dyad_fe, "fixest")) stats::nobs(ppml_dyad_fe) else NA_integer_,
    estimated = inherits(ppml_dyad_fe, "fixest"),
    note = if (inherits(ppml_dyad_fe, "fixest")) "Estimated" else conditionMessage(ppml_dyad_fe))
}

cat("\nDyad-FE model check:\n")
print(dyad_fe_model_check, n = Inf, width = Inf)

if (inherits(ppml_dyad_fe, "fixest")) {
  fixest::etable(
    ppml_single_no_cepii,
    ppml_dyad_fe,
    vcov = list(~ dyad_id, ~ dyad_id),
    tex = FALSE,
    fitstat = ~ n + ll + pr2 + bic)
}
```

# Appendix Analysis: Exploratory Heterogeneity by Income Configuration

This section examines whether the ranking of architecture families
differs across directed income configurations. The analysis uses annual
World Bank income classifications and collapses lower-middle and
upper-middle income into a single middle-income category. The nine
directed configurations are high-to-high, high-to-middle, high-to-low,
middle-to-high, middle-to-middle, middle-to-low, low-to-high,
low-to-middle, and low-to-low. Results are exploratory and are reported
with explicit cell-size diagnostics.

```{r income-configuration-input-check, include=FALSE}
# ---- INCOME-CONFIGURATION INPUT CHECK --------------------------------------

required_income_objects <- c(
  "ward_family_trade_panel_single_controls",
  "family_label_lookup",
  "baseline_family_short")

missing_income_objects <- required_income_objects[!vapply(required_income_objects, exists, logical(1))]

if (length(missing_income_objects) > 0) {
  stop(paste("Missing required object(s):", paste(missing_income_objects, collapse = ", ")))
}

required_income_columns <- c(
  "exporter_iso3", "importer_iso3", "year", "exports_thousand_usd",
  "architecture_family_short", "architecture_family_factor", "dyad_id",
  "exporter_year", "importer_year", "cepii_log_dist", "cepii_contig",
  "cepii_comlang_off", "cepii_colony", "cepii_comcol", "cepii_smctry")

missing_income_columns <- setdiff(required_income_columns, names(ward_family_trade_panel_single_controls))

if (length(missing_income_columns) > 0) {
  stop(paste("Missing column(s) in ward_family_trade_panel_single_controls:", paste(missing_income_columns, collapse = ", ")))
}

minimum_income_pair_rows <- 1000
minimum_report_rows <- 10000
minimum_family_rows <- 200

# ---- LOAD WORLD BANK HISTORICAL INCOME CLASSIFICATION ----------------------

wb_income_history_file <- here::here(
  "wb_historical_income_classification.xlsx")

if (!file.exists(wb_income_history_file)) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Required input file not found: ",
      wb_income_history_file))
}

standardize_income_value <- function(x) {
  x_clean <- as.character(x) %>%
    stringr::str_squish() %>%
    stringr::str_to_lower()

  dplyr::case_when(
    x_clean %in% c("l", "lic", "low", "low income", "low-income") ~ "Low income",
    x_clean %in% c("lm", "lmc", "lower middle", "lower-middle", "lower middle income", "lower-middle income") ~ "Lower-middle income",
    x_clean %in% c("um", "umc", "upper middle", "upper-middle", "upper middle income", "upper-middle income") ~ "Upper-middle income",
    x_clean %in% c("h", "hic", "high", "high income", "high-income") ~ "High income",
    stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "^low") ~ "Low income",
    stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "lower.*middle") ~ "Lower-middle income",
    stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "upper.*middle") ~ "Upper-middle income",
    stringr::str_detect(x_clean, "^high") ~ "High income",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_)
}

clean_excel_names <- function(data) {
  nm <- names(data) %>% stringr::str_squish()
  blank <- is.na(nm) | nm == "" | stringr::str_detect(nm, "^\\.\\.\\.[0-9]+$")
  nm[blank] <- paste0("unnamed_", which(blank))
  nm[!blank] <- stringr::str_replace(nm[!blank], "\\.\\.\\.[0-9]+$", "")
  names(data) <- make.unique(nm, sep = "_")
  data
}

find_iso_column <- function(data) {
  nm <- names(data) %>%
    stringr::str_to_lower() %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]", "")

  priority <- which(nm %in% c("code", "countrycode", "economycode", "iso3", "iso3code", "countryiso3", "countryiso3code"))
  if (length(priority) > 0) return(names(data)[priority[1]])

  iso_counts <- vapply(data, function(x) {
    sum(stringr::str_detect(as.character(x), "^[A-Z]{3}$"), na.rm = TRUE)
  }, integer(1))

  if (max(iso_counts, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  names(data)[which.max(iso_counts)]
}

find_year_columns <- function(data) {
  year_columns <- names(data)[stringr::str_detect(names(data), "^(19|20)[0-9]{2}$")]
  year_columns[as.integer(year_columns) >= 1995 & as.integer(year_columns) <= 2023]
}

read_income_candidate <- function(sheet_name, skip_rows) {
  candidate <- tryCatch(
    readxl::read_excel(wb_income_history_file, sheet = sheet_name, skip = skip_rows, col_names = TRUE, .name_repair = "unique_quiet"),
    error = function(e) NULL)

  if (is.null(candidate) || nrow(candidate) == 0 || ncol(candidate) == 0) return(NULL)

  candidate <- clean_excel_names(candidate)
  iso_column <- find_iso_column(candidate)
  year_columns <- find_year_columns(candidate)

  if (is.na(iso_column) || length(year_columns) == 0) return(NULL)

  income_long <- candidate %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(iso_column, year_columns))) %>%
    dplyr::rename(iso3 = dplyr::all_of(iso_column)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = dplyr::all_of(year_columns), names_to = "year", values_to = "income_raw") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      iso3 = stringr::str_to_upper(stringr::str_squish(as.character(iso3))),
      year = as.integer(year),
      income_group_wb = standardize_income_value(income_raw)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(stringr::str_detect(iso3, "^[A-Z]{3}$"), !is.na(year), !is.na(income_group_wb)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(iso3, year, income_group_wb)

  if (nrow(income_long) == 0) return(NULL)

  tibble::tibble(
    sheet = sheet_name,
    skip = skip_rows,
    iso_column = iso_column,
    year_columns = length(year_columns),
    valid_income_rows = nrow(income_long),
    data = list(income_long))
}

wb_income_candidates <- readxl::excel_sheets(wb_income_history_file) %>%
  purrr::map_dfr(function(sheet_name) {
    purrr::map_dfr(0:25, function(skip_rows) {
      candidate <- read_income_candidate(sheet_name, skip_rows)
      if (is.null(candidate)) return(tibble::tibble())
      candidate})})

if (nrow(wb_income_candidates) == 0) {
  stop("Could not identify a usable World Bank historical income table. Inspect the Excel file manually.")
}

wb_income_source_check <- wb_income_candidates %>%
  dplyr::select(sheet, skip, iso_column, year_columns, valid_income_rows) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(valid_income_rows))

wb_income_panel <- wb_income_candidates %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(valid_income_rows)) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%
  dplyr::pull(data) %>%
  purrr::pluck(1)

wb_income_panel_3cat <- wb_income_panel %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    income_group_3 = dplyr::case_when(
      income_group_wb == "Low income" ~ "Low income",
      income_group_wb %in% c("Lower-middle income", "Upper-middle income") ~ "Middle income",
      income_group_wb == "High income" ~ "High income",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    income_code_3 = dplyr::case_when(
      income_group_3 == "High income" ~ "high",
      income_group_3 == "Middle income" ~ "middle",
      income_group_3 == "Low income" ~ "low",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(income_code_3)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(iso3, year, income_group_wb, income_group_3, income_code_3)

wb_income_panel_check <- wb_income_panel_3cat %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    countries = dplyr::n_distinct(iso3),
    years_min = min(year, na.rm = TRUE),
    years_max = max(year, na.rm = TRUE),
    country_years = dplyr::n(),
    low_country_years = sum(income_code_3 == "low", na.rm = TRUE),
    middle_country_years = sum(income_code_3 == "middle", na.rm = TRUE),
    high_country_years = sum(income_code_3 == "high", na.rm = TRUE))

income_switcher_check_3cat <- wb_income_panel_3cat %>%
  dplyr::filter(year >= 1995, year <= 2023) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(iso3) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    years_observed = dplyr::n_distinct(year),
    income_groups_observed = dplyr::n_distinct(income_code_3),
    first_income_code = income_code_3[which.min(year)],
    last_income_code = income_code_3[which.max(year)],
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    countries = dplyr::n(),
    countries_switching_income_group = sum(income_groups_observed > 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    share_switching_income_group = round(countries_switching_income_group / countries, 3),
    countries_low_to_middle = sum(first_income_code == "low" & last_income_code == "middle", na.rm = TRUE),
    countries_middle_to_high = sum(first_income_code == "middle" & last_income_code == "high", na.rm = TRUE),
    countries_low_to_high = sum(first_income_code == "low" & last_income_code == "high", na.rm = TRUE))

print(wb_income_source_check %>% dplyr::slice(1), n = Inf)
print(wb_income_panel_check, n = Inf)
print(income_switcher_check_3cat, n = Inf)

# ---- CONSTRUCT DIRECTED INCOME-CONFIGURATION PANEL -------------------------

income_code_levels_3 <- c("high", "middle", "low")

income_pair_lookup_3 <- tidyr::expand_grid(

    income_pair_key_3 = paste(exporter_income_code_3, importer_income_code_3, sep = "_to_"),
    income_pair_label_3 = paste(stringr::str_to_title(exporter_income_code_3), importer_income_code_3, sep = " -> ")) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(exporter_order_3, importer_order_3)

income_pair_levels_key_3 <- income_pair_lookup_3 %>%

income_merge_check_3cat <- income_trade_panel_3cat_unfiltered %>%

income_trade_panel_3cat <- income_trade_panel_3cat_unfiltered %>%

income_pair_dyad_counts_3cat <- income_trade_panel_3cat %>%

    rows = sum(family_rows),

    smallest_family_cell = min(family_rows, na.rm = TRUE),
    eligible = rows >= minimum_income_pair_rows & families >= 2 & baseline_rows > 0,
    model_sample_sufficient = rows >= minimum_report_rows,
    .groups = "drop") %>%

    rows,
    directed_dyads,
    families,
    baseline_rows,
    smallest_family_cell,
    eligible,
    model_sample_sufficient) %>%

table_income_pair_model_eligibility_3cat <- income_pair_model_eligibility_3cat %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    `Income configuration` = as.character(income_pair_type_3),
    `Rows` = rows,
    `Directed dyads` = directed_dyads,
    `Families` = families,
    `Baseline rows` = baseline_rows,
    `Smallest family cell` = smallest_family_cell,
    `Estimated` = eligible,
    `Model sample sufficient` = model_sample_sufficient)

estimate_income_pair_model <- function(model_data) {
  model_data <- model_data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      architecture_family_factor = factor(architecture_family_short),
      architecture_family_factor = stats::relevel(architecture_family_factor, ref = baseline_family_short))

  fixest::fepois(
    exports_thousand_usd ~ architecture_family_factor + cepii_log_dist + cepii_contig +
      cepii_comlang_off + cepii_colony + cepii_comcol + cepii_smctry |
      exporter_year + importer_year,
    data = model_data,
    vcov = ~ dyad_id)
}

income_pair_model_data_3cat <- income_trade_panel_3cat %>%
  dplyr::semi_join(
    income_pair_model_eligibility_3cat %>%
      dplyr::filter(eligible) %>%
      dplyr::select(income_pair_key_3),
    by = "income_pair_key_3") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(income_pair_key_3, income_pair_type_3) %>%
  tidyr::nest() %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

safe_income_pair_model <- purrr::safely(estimate_income_pair_model)

income_pair_models_3cat <- income_pair_model_data_3cat %>%
  dplyr::mutate(model_result = purrr::map(data, safe_income_pair_model)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    model = purrr::map(model_result, "result"),
    model_error = purrr::map_chr(model_result, function(x) {
      if (is.null(x$error)) return(NA_character_)
      as.character(x$error$message)}))

income_pair_model_check_3cat <- income_pair_models_3cat %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    estimation_rows = purrr::map_int(data, nrow),
    observations_used = purrr::map_int(model, function(x) {
      if (is.null(x)) return(NA_integer_)
      stats::nobs(x)})) %>%
  dplyr::select(income_pair_key_3, income_pair_type_3, estimation_rows, observations_used, model_error)

print(table_income_pair_model_eligibility_3cat, n = Inf, width = Inf)
print(income_pair_model_check_3cat, n = Inf, width = Inf)

# ---- RANKINGS AND PAIRWISE TESTS BY INCOME CONFIGURATION -------------------

income_pair_family_rankings_3cat <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
  list(
    model = income_pair_models_3cat$model,
    model_data = income_pair_models_3cat$data,
    group_key = income_pair_models_3cat$income_pair_key_3,
    group_label = income_pair_models_3cat$income_pair_type_3),
  function(model, model_data, group_key, group_label) {
    if (is.null(model)) return(tibble::tibble())
    make_family_ranking(model, model_data, family_label_lookup, as.character(group_key), as.character(group_label))}) %>%
  dplyr::rename(income_pair_key_3 = group_key, income_pair_type_3 = group_label) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    income_pair_model_eligibility_3cat %>% dplyr::select(income_pair_key_3, model_sample_sufficient),
    by = "income_pair_key_3") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    reportable_family_cell = family_rows >= minimum_family_rows,
    stable_family_estimate = is.finite(std_error) & std_error <= 2 & abs(estimate) <= 5,
    reportable_family_estimate = model_sample_sufficient & reportable_family_cell & stable_family_estimate)

income_pair_pairwise_contrasts_3cat <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
  list(
    model = income_pair_models_3cat$model,
    model_data = income_pair_models_3cat$data,
    group_key = income_pair_models_3cat$income_pair_key_3,
    group_label = income_pair_models_3cat$income_pair_type_3),
  function(model, model_data, group_key, group_label) {
    if (is.null(model)) return(tibble::tibble())
    ranking <- make_family_ranking(model, model_data, family_label_lookup, as.character(group_key), as.character(group_label))
    make_pairwise_contrasts(model, ranking, as.character(group_key), as.character(group_label))})

if (nrow(income_pair_pairwise_contrasts_3cat) > 0) {
  income_pair_pairwise_contrasts_3cat <- income_pair_pairwise_contrasts_3cat %>%
    dplyr::rename(income_pair_key_3 = group_key, income_pair_type_3 = group_label) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      income_pair_model_eligibility_3cat %>% dplyr::select(income_pair_key_3, model_sample_sufficient),
      by = "income_pair_key_3") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      reportable_cell_size = family_a_rows >= minimum_family_rows & family_b_rows >= minimum_family_rows,
      reportable_pairwise = model_sample_sufficient & reportable_cell_size & !is.na(p_value))
}

if (nrow(income_pair_pairwise_contrasts_3cat) > 0) {
  income_pair_top_family_tests_3cat <- income_pair_pairwise_contrasts_3cat %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      income_pair_family_rankings_3cat %>%

} else {

  ggplot2::geom_col() +
  ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = scales::comma(rows)), hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::comma, expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Directed dyad-years by income configuration",
    subtitle = "Single-family CEPII sample; time-varying World Bank income groups",
    x = "Dyad-years",
    y = NULL) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  ggplot2::theme(panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_blank())

income_pair_family_presence_plot_data_3cat <- income_pair_family_presence_3cat %>%
  dplyr::mutate(income_pair_type_3 = factor(as.character(income_pair_type_3), levels = rev(income_pair_levels_label_3)))

figure_income_pair_family_presence_3cat <- income_pair_family_presence_plot_data_3cat %>%
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(y = income_pair_type_3)) +
  ggplot2::geom_segment(
    ggplot2::aes(x = families_with_200_rows, xend = families_observed, yend = income_pair_type_3),
    linewidth = 0.4) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    ggplot2::aes(x = families_observed, shape = "Observed families"),
    size = 2.4) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    ggplot2::aes(x = families_with_200_rows, shape = "Families with at least 200 rows"),
    size = 2.4) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:9, limits = c(0, 9)) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Architecture-family coverage by income configuration",
    subtitle = "Observed families and families with at least 200 dyad-years",
    x = "Architecture families",
    y = NULL,
    shape = NULL) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  ggplot2::theme(panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_blank())

figure_family_income_composition_3cat <- family_income_pair_plot_data_3cat %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    architecture_family_label_short = forcats::fct_reorder(architecture_family_label_short, family_rows, .fun = sum)) %>%
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = income_pair_type_3, y = architecture_family_label_short, fill = row_share)) +
  ggplot2::geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    ggplot2::aes(label = dplyr::if_else(row_share >= 0.04, scales::percent(row_share, accuracy = 1), "")),
    size = 2.5) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_viridis_c(labels = scales::percent, option = "C", limits = c(0, NA)) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Architecture-family composition by income configuration",
    subtitle = "Cell values show family shares within each income configuration",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Share") +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank())

ranking_plot_data_3cat <- income_pair_family_rankings_3cat %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    reportable_family_estimate,
    architecture_family_short != baseline_family_short) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(income_pair_key_3, income_pair_type_3) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(estimate, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    income_pair_type_3 = factor(income_pair_type_3, levels = income_pair_levels_label_3),
    architecture_family_label_short = forcats::fct_reorder(architecture_family_label_short, estimate))

if (nrow(ranking_plot_data_3cat) > 0) {
  figure_income_pair_family_rankings_3cat <- ranking_plot_data_3cat %>%
    ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = estimate, y = architecture_family_label_short)) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    ggplot2::geom_point(size = 1.8) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ income_pair_type_3, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = "Top architecture-family coefficients by income configuration",
      subtitle = "Only reportable estimates are shown: sufficient income-pair sample, family cell >= 200, and stable standard error",
      x = "Coefficient relative to minimalist architecture",
      y = NULL) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    ggplot2::theme(panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_blank())
} else {
  figure_income_pair_family_rankings_3cat <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = "No reportable family-ranking cells available") +
    ggplot2::theme_void()
}

print(figure_income_pair_sample_size_3cat)
print(figure_income_pair_family_presence_3cat)
print(figure_family_income_composition_3cat)
print(figure_income_pair_family_rankings_3cat)
```

```{r export-thesis-appendix-and-github-supplement}
# ---- EXPORT THESIS APPENDIX AND GITHUB SUPPLEMENT --------------------------

appendix_output_folder <- here::here("output", "thesis_appendix")
github_output_folder <- here::here("output", "replication_diagnostics")

dir.create(appendix_output_folder, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(github_output_folder, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---- COMPLETE FAMILY-BY-INDEX RANKINGS -------------------------------------

complete_index_rankings <- ward_family_distinctive_indices %>%
  dplyr::left_join(architecture_family_labels, by = "architecture_family_id") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(architecture_family_id, architecture_family_label) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(deviation_from_sample), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(rank_within_family = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(architecture_family_id, rank_within_family) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    architecture_family_id,
    architecture_family_label,
    agreements,
    rank_within_family,
    index_name,
    family_mean,
    overall_mean,
    deviation_from_sample)

readr::write_csv(

# ---- MISSINGNESS BY TREATY VINTAGE -----------------------------------------

appendix_vintage_missingness <- vintage_missingness_check %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    treaty_vintage = factor(treaty_vintage, levels = c("Before 2005", "2005–2014", "2015–2023")),
    clustering_status = dplyr::if_else(included_in_clustering, "included", "excluded")) %>%
  dplyr::select(treaty_vintage, clustering_status, agreements) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = clustering_status, values_from = agreements, values_fill = 0) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    total_agreements = included + excluded,
    excluded_percent = round(100 * excluded / total_agreements, 1)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(treaty_vintage) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(treaty_vintage = as.character(treaty_vintage))

vintage_test_statistic <- if (is.null(vintage_missingness_test$statistic)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(vintage_missingness_test$statistic)
vintage_test_df <- if (is.null(vintage_missingness_test$parameter)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(vintage_missingness_test$parameter)

vintage_test_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  test = vintage_missingness_test$method,
  statistic = vintage_test_statistic,
  degrees_of_freedom = vintage_test_df,
  p_value = vintage_missingness_test$p.value)

readr::write_csv(

  file.path(appendix_output_folder, "missingness_by_treaty_vintage.csv"))
```
